desc_vn: Khi máu của anh hùng của chúng tôi dưới 40%, mỗi lần tấn công sẽ tăng 10% sát thương (có thể chồng chất).

desc_ma: Apabila HP wira kita di bawah 40%, setiap serangan meningkatkan kerosakan sebanyak 10% (boleh bertindih).

desc_en: Each time our hero loses 10% HP, damage increases by 8%.
desc_th: ทุกครั้งที่ฮีโร่ของเราเสียเลือด 10% ความเสียหายจะเพิ่มขึ้น 8%

desc_ma: Setiap kali wira kita kehilangan 10% HP, kerosakan meningkat 8%.

desc: Each time damage is dealt to an enemy, add 8% true damage based on our hero's lost HP.

desc_vn: Mỗi lần sử dụng tuyệt chiêu, sát thương sẽ tăng 10%, hiệu quả kéo dài đến khi trận chiến kết thúc.
desc_en: Each time ultimate skill is used, damage increases by 10%, effect lasts until the end of battle.
desc_th: ทุกครั้งที่ใช้สกิลอัลติเมท ความเสียหายจะเพิ่มขึ้น 10% มีผลจนจบการต่อสู้
desc_in: Setiap kali menggunakan skill ultimate, damage meningkat 10%, efek bertahan hingga akhir pertarungan.
desc_ph: Tuwing ginagamit ang ultimate skill, tumataas ang pinsala ng 10%, tumatagal hanggang matapos ang laban.
desc_ma: Setiap kali menggunakan kemahiran ultimate, kerosakan meningkat 10%, kesan bertahan sehingga tamat pertempuran.

desc: Each time a basic attack or small skill is used, the next ultimate skill damage increases by 10%, this increase is lost after using ultimate skill.
desc_vn: Mỗi lần sử dụng đòn đánh cơ bản hoặc kỹ năng nhỏ, lần sử dụng tuyệt chiêu tiếp theo sẽ tăng 10% sát thương, khi sử dụng tuyệt chiêu, phần tăng này sẽ mất đi.
desc_en: Each time a basic attack or small skill is used, the next ultimate skill damage increases by 10%, this increase is lost after using ultimate skill.
desc_th: ทุกครั้งที่ใช้การโจมตีปกติหรือสกิลเล็ก สกิลอัลติเมทครั้งต่อไปจะเพิ่มความเสียหาย 10% และส่วนนี้จะหายไปเมื่อใช้สกิลอัลติเมท
desc_in: Setiap kali menggunakan serangan dasar atau skill kecil, penggunaan skill ultimate berikutnya meningkat 10% damage, peningkatan ini hilang setelah menggunakan skill ultimate.
desc_ph: Tuwing gumagamit ng basic attack o maliit na skill, ang susunod na ultimate skill ay tataas ng 10% pinsala, mawawala ang dagdag na ito pagkatapos gamitin ang ultimate.
desc_ma: Setiap kali menggunakan serangan asas atau kemahiran kecil, kemahiran ultimate seterusnya meningkat 10% kerosakan, peningkatan ini hilang selepas menggunakan kemahiran ultimate.

desc: When our hero's HP is below 50%, receive 20% damage reduction until the end of battle.
desc_vn: Khi máu của anh hùng của chúng tôi dưới 50%, nhận thêm 20% giảm sát thương cho đến khi trận chiến kết thúc.
desc_en: When our hero's HP is below 50%, receive 20% damage reduction until the end of battle.
desc_th: เมื่อเลือดของฮีโร่ของเราต่ำกว่า 50% รับการลดความเสียหายเพิ่ม 20% จนจบการต่อสู้
desc_in: Ketika HP pahlawan kita di bawah 50%, terima pengurangan damage tambahan 20% hingga akhir pertarungan.
desc_ph: Kapag ang HP ng aming bayani ay mas mababa sa 50%, makatanggap ng dagdag na 20% bawas pinsala hanggang matapos ang laban.
desc_ma: Apabila HP wira kita di bawah 50%, terima pengurangan kerosakan tambahan 20% sehingga tamat pertempuran.

desc: When our hero's HP is below 30%, increase lifesteal by 30% until the end of battle.
desc_vn: Khi máu của anh hùng của chúng tôi dưới 30%, tăng thêm 30% hút máu cho đến khi trận chiến kết thúc.
desc_en: When our hero's HP is below 30%, increase lifesteal by 30% until the end of battle.
desc_th: เมื่อเลือดของฮีโร่ของเราต่ำกว่า 30% เพิ่มการดูดเลือด 30% จนจบการต่อสู้
desc_in: Ketika HP pahlawan kita di bawah 30%, tingkatkan lifesteal sebesar 30% hingga akhir pertarungan.
desc_ph: Kapag ang HP ng aming bayani ay mas mababa sa 30%, dagdagan ang lifesteal ng 30% hanggang matapos ang laban.
desc_ma: Apabila HP wira kita di bawah 30%, tingkatkan lifesteal sebanyak 30% sehingga tamat pertempuran.

desc: Each time damage is received, increase physical and magical defense by 15%, stacks up to 3 times, lasts 2 turns.
desc_vn: Mỗi lần nhận sát thương, tăng 15% phòng thủ vật lý và pháp thuật, tối đa cộng dồn 3 lần, kéo dài 2 lượt.
desc_en: Each time damage is received, increase physical and magical defense by 15%, stacks up to 3 times, lasts 2 turns.
desc_th: ทุกครั้งที่ได้รับความเสียหาย เพิ่มพลังป้องกันกายภาพและเวทมนตร์ 15% ซ้อนกันได้สูงสุด 3 ครั้ง มีผล 2 เทิร์น
desc_in: Setiap kali menerima damage, tingkatkan pertahanan fisik dan sihir sebesar 15%, maksimal 3 kali bertumpuk, bertahan selama 2 giliran.
desc_ph: Tuwing nakakatanggap ng pinsala, dagdagan ang physical at magical defense ng 15%, pwedeng mag-stack ng hanggang 3 beses, tumatagal ng 2 turn.
desc_ma: Setiap kali menerima kerosakan, tingkatkan pertahanan fizikal dan magik sebanyak 15%, bertindih sehingga 3 kali, bertahan 2 giliran.

desc: Each time our hero's HP decreases by 10%, increase lifesteal by 5%.
desc_vn: Mỗi khi máu của anh hùng giảm 10%, tăng 5% hút máu.
desc_en: Each time our hero's HP decreases by 10%, increase lifesteal by 5%.
desc_th: ทุกครั้งที่เลือดของฮีโร่ลดลง 10% เพิ่มการดูดเลือด 5%
desc_in: Setiap kali HP pahlawan berkurang 10%, tingkatkan lifesteal sebesar 5%.
desc_ph: Tuwing bumababa ang HP ng aming bayani ng 10%, dagdagan ang lifesteal ng 5%.
desc_ma: Setiap kali HP wira berkurang 10%, tingkatkan lifesteal sebanyak 5%.

desc: Convert all lifesteal components into a shield layer (shield = max HP * lifesteal rate * 1.5), shield lasts 2 turns.
desc_vn: Chuyển tất cả các thành phần hút máu thành lớp khiên (lớp khiên = giới hạn máu * tỷ lệ hút máu * 1.5), khiên duy trì 2 lượt.
desc_en: Convert all lifesteal components into a shield layer (shield = max HP * lifesteal rate * 1.5), shield lasts 2 turns.
desc_th: เปลี่ยนส่วนประกอบการดูดเลือดทั้งหมดเป็นเกราะ (เกราะ = พลังชีวิตสูงสุด * อัตราการดูดเลือด * 1.5) เกราะมีผล 2 เทิร์น
desc_in: Ubah semua komponen lifesteal menjadi lapisan perisai (perisai = HP maksimal * tingkat lifesteal * 1.5), perisai bertahan 2 giliran.
desc_ph: I-convert lahat ng lifesteal components sa shield layer (shield = max HP * lifesteal rate * 1.5), tumatagal ang shield ng 2 turn.
desc_ma: Tukar semua komponen lifesteal kepada lapisan perisai (perisai = HP maksimum * kadar lifesteal * 1.5), perisai bertahan 2 giliran.

desc: When having shield, immune to control effects.
desc_vn: Khi có khiên, miễn nhiễm hiệu ứng kiểm soát.
desc_en: When having shield, immune to control effects.
desc_th: เมื่อมีเกราะ ป้องกันสถานะควบคุม
desc_in: Saat memiliki perisai, kebal terhadap efek kontrol.
desc_ph: Kapag may shield, immune sa control effects.
desc_ma: Apabila mempunyai perisai, kebal terhadap kesan kawalan.

desc: When receiving damage, 5% chance to silence the attacker for 1 turn.
desc_vn: Khi nhận sát thương, có 5% tỷ lệ gây im lặng đối với kẻ tấn công trong 1 lượt.
desc_en: When receiving damage, 5% chance to silence the attacker for 1 turn.
desc_th: เมื่อได้รับความเสียหาย มีโอกาส 5% ที่จะทำให้ศัตรูเงียบเป็นเวลา 1 เทิร์น
desc_in: Saat menerima damage, ada peluang 5% untuk membungkam penyerang selama 1 giliran.
desc_ph: Kapag nakakatanggap ng pinsala, may 5% chance na ma-silence ang attacker ng 1 turn.
desc_ma: Apabila menerima kerosakan, ada peluang 5% untuk menyenyapkan penyerang selama 1 giliran.

desc: At the start of the battle, gain 100 rage points.
desc_vn: Khi bắt đầu trận đấu, nhận thêm 100 điểm tức.
desc_en: At the start of the battle, gain 100 rage points.
desc_th: เมื่อเริ่มการต่อสู้ รับพลังโกรธ 100 แต้ม
desc_in: Saat mulai pertarungan, dapatkan 100 poin amarah.
desc_ph: Sa simula ng laban, tumanggap ng 100 puntos ng galit.
desc_ma: Pada permulaan pertempuran, dapatkan 100 mata kemarahan.

desc: When defeating an enemy, gain 100 rage points.
desc_vn: Khi đánh bại kẻ địch, nhận thêm 100 điểm tức.
desc_en: When defeating an enemy, gain 100 rage points.
desc_th: เมื่อฆ่าศัตรู รับพลังโกรธ 100 แต้ม
desc_in: Saat mengalahkan musuh, dapatkan 100 poin amarah.
desc_ph: Kapag napatay ang kalaban, tumanggap ng 100 puntos ng galit.
desc_ma: Apabila mengalahkan musuh, dapatkan 100 mata kemarahan.

desc: When receiving damage, gain 100 rage points.
desc_vn: Khi nhận sát thương, nhận thêm 100 điểm tức.
desc_en: When receiving damage, gain 100 rage points.
desc_th: เมื่อได้รับความเสียหาย รับพลังโกรธ 100 แต้ม
desc_in: Saat menerima damage, dapatkan 100 poin amarah.
desc_ph: Kapag nakatanggap ng pinsala, tumanggap ng 100 puntos ng galit.
desc_ma: Apabila menerima kerosakan, dapatkan 100 mata kemarahan.

desc: Provide all present heroes with current attribute * 5% (only main attribute) physical and magic attack.
desc_vn: Cung cấp cho tất cả anh hùng có mặt thuộc tính hiện tại * 5% (chỉ tính thuộc tính chính) tấn công vật lý và phép thuật.
desc_en: Provide all present heroes with current attribute * 5% (only main attribute) physical and magic attack.
desc_th: มอบพลังโจมตีทางกายภาพและเวทมนตร์ให้ฮีโร่ทุกคนที่อยู่ในสนาม เท่ากับ 5% ของค่าสถานะหลักปัจจุบัน
desc_in: Berikan semua pahlawan yang hadir atribut saat ini * 5% (hanya atribut utama) serangan fisik dan sihir.
desc_ph: Bigyan lahat ng bayani sa laban ng kasalukuyang attribute * 5% (pangunahing attribute lang) physical at magic attack.
desc_ma: Berikan semua wira yang hadir atribut semasa * 5% (hanya atribut utama) serangan fizikal dan magik.

desc: Each battle, a random hero gains an additional 20% physical and magic attack.
desc_vn: Mỗi trận chiến, ngẫu nhiên một anh hùng nhận thêm 20% tấn công vật lý và phép thuật.
desc_en: Each battle, a random hero gains an additional 20% physical and magic attack.
desc_th: ในแต่ละการต่อสู้ ฮีโร่สุ่มหนึ่งคนจะได้รับพลังโจมตีทางกายภาพและเวทมนตร์เพิ่มขึ้น 20%
desc_in: Setiap pertarungan, satu pahlawan acak mendapat tambahan 20% serangan fisik dan sihir.
desc_ph: Bawat laban, random na isang bayani ang tumatanggap ng dagdag na 20% physical at magic attack.
desc_ma: Setiap pertempuran, seorang wira rawak mendapat tambahan 20% serangan fizikal dan magik.

desc: Calculate the main attribute of all heroes in battle. The hero with the highest attribute count gains 5% Physical and Magic Attack.
desc_vn: Tính toán thuộc tính của các anh hùng tham chiến (chỉ tính thuộc tính chính), tăng thêm số lượng * 5% tấn công vật lý và phép thuật cho anh hùng sử dụng nhiều thuộc tính nhất.
desc_en: Calculate the main attribute of all heroes in battle. The hero with the highest attribute count gains 5% Physical and Magic Attack.
desc_th: คำนวณค่าสถานะหลักของฮีโร่ทุกตัวที่เข้าร่วมการต่อสู้ ฮีโร่ที่มีค่าสถานะมากที่สุดจะได้รับพลังโจมตีกายภาพและเวทมนตร์เพิ่มขึ้น 5%
desc_in: Hitung atribut utama dari semua pahlawan yang ikut bertarung. Pahlawan dengan jumlah atribut terbanyak mendapatkan 5% Serangan Fisik dan Sihir.
desc_ph: Kalkulahin ang pangunahing attribute ng lahat ng bayani sa labanan. Ang bayani na may pinakamaraming attribute ay makakakuha ng 5% Physical at Magic Attack.
desc_ma: Kira atribut utama semua wira yang bertempur. Wira dengan jumlah atribut tertinggi mendapat 5% Serangan Fizikal dan Ajaib.

desc: When dealing magic damage, gain 5% Critical Rate for 2 turns. Can stack up to 4 times. Stacking refreshes duration.
desc_vn: Khi gây sát thương phép thuật, tỷ lệ chí mạng tăng 5%, kéo dài 2 lượt, có thể cộng dồn tối đa 4 lần, cộng dồn sẽ làm mới thời gian kéo dài.
desc_en: When dealing magic damage, gain 5% Critical Rate for 2 turns. Can stack up to 4 times. Stacking refreshes duration.
desc_th: เมื่อสร้างความเสียหายเวทมนตร์ จะได้รับอัตราคริติคอลเพิ่มขึ้น 5% เป็นเวลา 2 เทิร์น สามารถสะสมได้สูงสุด 4 ครั้ง การสะสมจะรีเฟรชระยะเวลา
desc_in: Saat memberikan damage sihir, dapatkan 5% Peluang Kritis selama 2 giliran. Dapat ditumpuk hingga 4 kali. Penumpukan memperbarui durasi.
desc_ph: Kapag nagdulot ng magic damage, makakakuha ng 5% Critical Rate sa loob ng 2 turns. Pwedeng i-stack hanggang 4 na beses. Ang pag-stack ay nire-reset ang tagal.
desc_ma: Apabila menyebabkan kerosakan sihir, dapatkan 5% Kadar Kritikal selama 2 giliran. Boleh ditumpuk sehingga 4 kali. Penumpukan menyegar semula tempoh.

desc: Every 20% Magic Attack increase grants an additional 10% Physical Attack.
desc_vn: Mỗi khi nhận được 20% tăng pháp thuật, có thể nhận thêm 10% tấn công vật lý.
desc_en: Every 20% Magic Attack increase grants an additional 10% Physical Attack.
desc_th: ทุกการเพิ่มพลังเวทมนตร์ 20% จะได้รับพลังโจมตีกายภาพเพิ่มขึ้น 10%
desc_in: Setiap peningkatan 20% Serangan Sihir memberikan tambahan 10% Serangan Fisik.
desc_ph: Bawat 20% dagdag sa Magic Attack ay nagbibigay ng dagdag na 10% Physical Attack.
desc_ma: Setiap kenaikan 20% Serangan Ajaib memberikan tambahan 10% Serangan Fizikal.

desc: Increase Critical Damage by 20%. When landing a critical hit, restore 10% of max HP.
desc_vn: Tăng 20% sát thương chí mạng, khi gây chí mạng sẽ hồi phục 10% máu tối đa.
desc_en: Increase Critical Damage by 20%. When landing a critical hit, restore 10% of max HP.
desc_th: เพิ่มความเสียหายคริติคอล 20% เมื่อติดคริติคอลจะฟื้นฟู HP สูงสุด 10%
desc_in: Tingkatkan Kerusakan Kritis sebesar 20%. Saat mengenai kritis, pulihkan 10% HP maksimum.
desc_ph: Dagdagan ang Critical Damage ng 20%. Kapag nag-critical, magre-regen ng 10% ng max HP.
desc_ma: Tingkatkan Kerosakan Kritikal sebanyak 20%. Apabila mengenai kritikal, pulihkan 10% HP maksimum.

desc: Every 20% Physical Attack increase grants an additional 10% Magic Attack.
desc_vn: Mỗi khi nhận được 20% tấn công vật lý, có thể nhận thêm 10% tấn công phép thuật.
desc_en: Every 20% Physical Attack increase grants an additional 10% Magic Attack.
desc_th: ทุกการเพิ่มพลังโจมตีกายภาพ 20% จะได้รับพลังโจมตีเวทเพิ่มขึ้น 10%
desc_in: Setiap peningkatan 20% Serangan Fisik memberikan tambahan 10% Serangan Sihir.
desc_ph: Bawat 20% Physical Attack ay nagbibigay ng dagdag na 10% Magic Attack.
desc_ma: Setiap kenaikan 20% Serangan Fizikal memberikan tambahan 10% Serangan Ajaib.

desc: When dealing damage to a controlled enemy, remove their control effect and deal damage equal to 20% of their current HP.
desc_vn: Khi gây sát thương cho kẻ địch bị kiểm soát, sẽ giải trừ hiệu ứng kiểm soát của chúng và gây sát thương bằng 20% máu hiện tại của chúng.
desc_en: When dealing damage to a controlled enemy, remove their control effect and deal damage equal to 20% of their current HP.
desc_th: เมื่อสร้างความเสียหายต่อศัตรูที่ถูกควบคุม จะลบสถานะควบคุมและสร้างความเสียหายเท่ากับ 20% ของ HP ปัจจุบันของพวกเขา
desc_in: Saat memberikan damage kepada musuh yang terkena kontrol, hilangkan efek kontrol mereka dan berikan damage sebesar 20% dari HP saat ini mereka.
desc_ph: Kapag nakadamage sa kontroladong kalaban, aalisin ang kontrol at magdudulot ng damage na katumbas ng 20% ng kanilang kasalukuyang HP.
desc_ma: Apabila menyebabkan kerosakan kepada musuh yang dikawal, nyah kawalan mereka dan kenakan kerosakan sebanyak 20% daripada HP semasa mereka.

desc: When dealing magic critical hit, increase this critical damage by 20% and heal 5% of the damage dealt.
desc_vn: Khi gây sát thương chí mạng phép, tăng thêm 20% sát thương chí mạng lần này và hồi phục 5% giá trị sát thương đó dưới dạng máu.
desc_en: When dealing magic critical hit, increase this critical damage by 20% and heal 5% of the damage dealt.
desc_th: เมื่อคริติคอลเวท จะเพิ่มความเสียหายคริติคอลครั้งนี้ 20% และฟื้นฟู 5% ของความเสียหายนั้นเป็น HP
desc_in: Saat menghasilkan critical damage sihir, tingkatkan kerusakan kritis tersebut sebesar 20% dan pulihkan 5% dari damage sebagai HP.
desc_ph: Kapag magic critical ang attack, dadagdagan ng 20% ang critical damage at mag-heal ng 5% ng damage bilang HP.
desc_ma: Apabila menghasilkan serangan kritikal ajaib, tingkatkan kerosakan kritikal itu sebanyak 20% dan pulihkan 5% daripada jumlah kerosakan sebagai HP.

desc: At the end of each round, remove one random control effect from all our heroes.
desc_vn: Mỗi khi kết thúc một vòng lớn, giải trừ một hiệu ứng kiểm soát ngẫu nhiên trên tất cả anh hùng của chúng tôi.
desc_en: At the end of each round, remove one random control effect from all our heroes.
desc_th: เมื่อจบรอบ จะลบสถานะควบคุมแบบสุ่ม 1 อย่างจากฮีโร่ฝ่ายเรา
desc_in: Di akhir setiap ronde, hilangkan satu efek kontrol secara acak dari semua pahlawan kita.
desc_ph: Tuwing matapos ang isang round, aalisin ang isang random control effect sa lahat ng ating bayani.
desc_ma: Pada akhir setiap pusingan, buang satu kesan kawalan rawak dari semua wira kami.

desc: When attacking, all remaining DoT effects on the target take effect instantly.
desc_vn: Khi tấn công, tính toán tất cả sát thương liên tục trên mục tiêu, khiến tất cả sát thương liên tục còn lại trên mục tiêu có hiệu lực ngay lập tức.
desc_en: When attacking, all remaining DoT effects on the target take effect instantly.
desc_th: เมื่อโจมตี สถานะความเสียหายต่อเนื่องทั้งหมดที่เหลืออยู่บนเป้าหมายจะมีผลทันที
desc_in: Saat menyerang, semua efek damage terus-menerus yang tersisa pada target langsung berlaku.
desc_ph: Kapag umatake, lahat ng natitirang DoT sa target ay magkakaroon ng epekto agad.
desc_ma: Apabila menyerang, semua kesan kerosakan berterusan yang tinggal pada sasaran akan berlaku serta-merta.

desc: At the start of each turn, remove one negative effect from self. Each removal grants 5% increased damage and 5% damage reduction for the turn. Can stack up to 4 times.
desc_vn: Mỗi khi bắt đầu một lượt, giải trừ một hiệu ứng tiêu cực trên bản thân, mỗi lần giải trừ, sẽ nhận thêm 5% tăng sát thương và 5% giảm sát thương trong lượt đó, tối đa có thể cộng dồn 4 lần.
desc_en: At the start of each turn, remove one negative effect from self. Each removal grants 5% increased damage and 5% damage reduction for the turn. Can stack up to 4 times.
desc_th: เมื่อเริ่มเทิร์น จะลบสถานะลบ 1 อย่างจากตัวเอง ทุกครั้งที่ลบจะเพิ่มความเสียหาย 5% และลดความเสียหายที่ได้รับ 5% สำหรับเทิร์นนั้น สะสมได้สูงสุด 4 ครั้ง
desc_in: Saat memulai giliran, hilangkan satu efek negatif dari diri sendiri. Setiap penghapusan memberikan 5% peningkatan damage dan 5% pengurangan damage selama giliran itu. Dapat ditumpuk hingga 4 kali.
desc_ph: Sa simula ng bawat turn, alisin ang isang negative effect sa sarili. Kada tanggal ay makakakuha ng 5% bonus damage at 5% damage reduction sa turn na iyon, hanggang 4 stacks.
desc_ma: Pada permulaan setiap giliran, buang satu kesan negatif daripada diri sendiri. Setiap penghapusan memberikan 5% peningkatan serangan dan 5% pengurangan kerosakan untuk giliran itu. Boleh ditumpuk sehingga 4 kali.

desc: When attacked, reduce the attacker’s Physical and Magic Attack by 5%. Can stack up to 6 times.
desc_vn: Khi bị tấn công, giảm 5% tấn công vật lý và phép của mục tiêu, tối đa có thể cộng dồn 6 lần.
desc_en: When attacked, reduce the attacker’s Physical and Magic Attack by 5%. Can stack up to 6 times.
desc_th: เมื่อถูกโจมตี จะลดพลังโจมตีกายภาพและเวทของศัตรูลง 5% สูงสุดสะสม 6 ครั้ง
desc_in: Saat diserang, kurangi Serangan Fisik dan Sihir penyerang sebesar 5%. Dapat ditumpuk hingga 6 kali.
desc_ph: Kapag inatake, babawasan ng 5% ang Physical at Magic Attack ng kalaban. Pwedeng i-stack hanggang 6 na beses.
desc_ma: Apabila diserang, kurangkan Serangan Fizikal dan Ajaib musuh sebanyak 5%. Boleh ditumpuk sehingga 6 kali.

desc: Every 2% Lifesteal bonus increases damage by 1%.
desc_vn: Mỗi 2% hút máu cộng thêm, sẽ tăng 1% sát thương.
desc_en: Every 2% Lifesteal bonus increases damage by 1%.
desc_th: ทุกค่าการดูดเลือดเพิ่มขึ้น 2% จะเพิ่มความเสียหาย 1%
desc_in: Setiap tambahan 2% Lifesteal meningkatkan damage sebesar 1%.
desc_ph: Bawat dagdag na 2% Lifesteal ay nagbibigay ng 1% dagdag na damage.
desc_ma: Setiap 2% penyerapan nyawa tambahan memberikan 1% kerosakan tambahan.

desc: Each attack permanently reduces the enemy’s Physical and Magic Attack by 10% for 2 turns. Can stack up to 4 times.
desc_vn: Mỗi lần tấn công, sẽ giảm vĩnh viễn 10% tấn công vật lý và phép của kẻ địch, kéo dài 2 lượt, tối đa có thể cộng dồn 4 lần.
desc_en: Each attack permanently reduces the enemy’s Physical and Magic Attack by 10% for 2 turns. Can stack up to 4 times.
desc_th: แต่ละครั้งที่โจมตี จะลดพลังโจมตีกายภาพและเวทของศัตรูถาวร 10% เป็นเวลา 2 เทิร์น สูงสุดสะสม 4 ครั้ง
desc_in: Setiap serangan mengurangi Serangan Fisik dan Sihir musuh secara permanen sebesar 10% selama 2 giliran. Dapat ditumpuk hingga 4 kali.
desc_ph: Bawat atake ay permanenteng bumabawas ng 10% Physical at Magic Attack ng kalaban sa loob ng 2 turns. Hanggang 4 na stack.
desc_ma: Setiap serangan mengurangkan Serangan Fizikal dan Ajaib musuh sebanyak 10% secara kekal selama 2 giliran. Boleh ditumpuk sehingga 4 kali.

desc: Every 2% Lifesteal bonus increases damage by 1%.
desc_vn: Mỗi 2% hút máu cộng thêm, sẽ tăng 1% sát thương.
desc_en: Every 2% Lifesteal bonus increases damage by 1%.
desc_th: ทุกค่าการดูดเลือดเพิ่มขึ้น 2% จะเพิ่มความเสียหาย 1%
desc_in: Setiap tambahan 2% Lifesteal meningkatkan damage sebesar 1%.
desc_ph: Bawat dagdag na 2% Lifesteal ay nagbibigay ng 1% dagdag na damage.
desc_ma: Setiap 2% penyerapan nyawa tambahan memberikan 1% kerosakan tambahan.

desc: After dealing damage, heal for 15% of the damage dealt.
desc_vn: Sau khi gây sát thương, nhận lại 15% lượng sát thương đã gây ra dưới dạng hồi phục.
desc_en: After dealing damage, heal for 15% of the damage dealt.
desc_th: หลังจากสร้างความเสียหาย จะฟื้นฟู HP เท่ากับ 15% ของความเสียหายที่สร้าง
desc_in: Setelah memberikan damage, pulihkan 15% dari damage yang diberikan sebagai HP.
desc_ph: Pagkatapos makadamage, mag-heal ng 15% ng damage bilang HP.
desc_ma: Selepas menyebabkan kerosakan, pulihkan 15% daripada kerosakan sebagai HP.

desc: Each time damage is dealt, additional damage equal to the hero's shield value is added.
desc_vn: Mỗi lần gây sát thương, sẽ thêm sát thương bằng với giá trị khiên của bản thân.
desc_en: Each time damage is dealt, additional damage equal to the hero's shield value is added.
desc_th: ทุกครั้งที่สร้างความเสียหาย จะเพิ่มความเสียหายเท่ากับค่าบาเรียของตนเอง
desc_in: Setiap kali memberikan damage, tambahkan damage tambahan sebesar nilai perisai hero.
desc_ph: Tuwing may damage, may karagdagang damage batay sa halaga ng sariling shield.
desc_ma: Setiap kali menyebabkan kerosakan, tambah kerosakan tambahan bersamaan dengan nilai perisai diri sendiri.

desc: When dealing damage, increase damage based on the current ratio of shield to current HP.
desc_vn: Khi gây sát thương, tăng thêm sát thương bằng tỷ lệ hiện tại của khiên/và máu hiện tại.
desc_en: When dealing damage, increase damage based on the current ratio of shield to current HP.
desc_th: เมื่อสร้างความเสียหาย จะเพิ่มความเสียหายตามอัตราส่วนระหว่างค่าบาเรียกับ HP ปัจจุบัน
desc_in: Saat memberikan damage, tingkatkan damage berdasarkan rasio perisai saat ini terhadap HP saat ini.
desc_ph: Kapag nagdulot ng damage, tataas ang damage base sa ratio ng kasalukuyang shield sa kasalukuyang HP.
desc_ma: Apabila menyebabkan kerosakan, tingkatkan kerosakan berdasarkan nisbah perisai semasa berbanding HP semasa.

desc: In the next battle, when our hero kills an enemy, gain 100% Physical Attack for 2 turns.
desc_vn: Trong trận chiến tiếp theo, khi anh hùng của chúng tôi tiêu diệt kẻ địch, sẽ nhận được 100% tấn công vật lý, kéo dài 2 lượt.
desc_en: In the next battle, when our hero kills an enemy, gain 100% Physical Attack for 2 turns.
desc_th: ในการต่อสู้ถัดไป เมื่อฮีโร่ของเรากำจัดศัตรู จะได้รับพลังโจมตีกายภาพเพิ่ม 100% เป็นเวลา 2 เทิร์น
desc_in: Dalam pertempuran berikutnya, ketika pahlawan kita membunuh musuh, dapatkan 100% Serangan Fisik selama 2 giliran.
desc_ph: Sa susunod na laban, kapag nakapatay ang ating bayani, makakakuha ng 100% Physical Attack sa loob ng 2 turns.
desc_ma: Dalam pertempuran seterusnya, apabila wira kita membunuh musuh, dapatkan 100% Serangan Fizikal selama 2 giliran.

desc: At the start of the next battle, our first hero will deal double damage.
desc_vn: Khi trận chiến tiếp theo bắt đầu, anh hùng đầu tiên của chúng tôi sẽ gây sát thương gấp đôi.
desc_en: At the start of the next battle, our first hero will deal double damage.
desc_th: เมื่อเริ่มการต่อสู้ถัดไป ฮีโร่ตัวแรกของเราจะสร้างความเสียหายเป็น 2 เท่า
desc_in: Saat pertempuran berikutnya dimulai, pahlawan pertama kita akan memberikan damage dua kali lipat.
desc_ph: Sa simula ng susunod na laban, ang una nating bayani ay magdudulot ng double damage.
desc_ma: Apabila pertempuran seterusnya bermula, wira pertama kita akan menyebabkan dua kali ganda kerosakan.

desc: At the start of the next battle, there is a 15% chance to halve the current HP of an enemy. This can only trigger in the first challenge attempt and will not activate in subsequent attempts.
desc_vn: Khi trận chiến tiếp theo bắt đầu, có 15% cơ hội làm giảm nửa máu hiện tại của kẻ địch, chỉ có thể kích hoạt khi thách đấu lần đầu tiên, lần thách đấu sau sẽ không kích hoạt.
desc_en: At the start of the next battle, there is a 15% chance to halve the current HP of an enemy. This can only trigger in the first challenge attempt and will not activate in subsequent attempts.
desc_th: เมื่อเริ่มการต่อสู้ถัดไป มีโอกาส 15% ที่จะลด HP ปัจจุบันของศัตรูลงครึ่งหนึ่ง ใช้ได้เฉพาะในการท้าทายครั้งแรกเท่านั้น ครั้งต่อไปจะไม่ทำงาน
desc_in: Saat pertempuran berikutnya dimulai, ada 15% peluang untuk mengurangi separuh HP musuh. Hanya aktif pada tantangan pertama, tidak berlaku untuk tantangan berikutnya.
desc_ph: Sa simula ng susunod na laban, may 15% tsansa na bawasan ng kalahati ang kasalukuyang HP ng kalaban. Gagana lang ito sa unang hamon, hindi na uulit sa mga susunod.
desc_ma: Apabila pertempuran seterusnya bermula, ada 15% peluang untuk mengurangkan separuh HP semasa musuh. Hanya boleh dicetuskan pada cubaan cabaran pertama.

desc: At the start of the next battle, there is a 50% chance for enemies to instantly die (each enemy calculated independently).
desc_vn: Khi trận chiến tiếp theo bắt đầu, có 50% xác suất kẻ địch trực tiếp chết (mỗi kẻ địch tính riêng xác suất).
desc_en: At the start of the next battle, there is a 50% chance for enemies to instantly die (each enemy calculated independently).
desc_th: เมื่อเริ่มการต่อสู้ถัดไป มีโอกาส 50% ที่ศัตรูจะตายทันที (คำนวณแยกแต่ละศัตรู)
desc_in: Saat pertempuran berikutnya dimulai, ada 50% kemungkinan musuh mati langsung (masing-masing musuh dihitung secara terpisah).
desc_ph: Sa simula ng susunod na laban, may 50% na posibilidad na mamatay agad ang kalaban (hiwalay ang tsansa kada kalaban).
desc_ma: Apabila pertempuran seterusnya bermula, ada 50% peluang untuk musuh mati serta-merta (setiap musuh dikira berasingan).

desc: Each time a hero of one attribute is used, gain 2% damage reduction.
desc_vn: Mỗi khi sử dụng anh hùng thuộc một thuộc tính, sẽ nhận thêm 2% giảm sát thương.
desc_en: Each time a hero of one attribute is used, gain 2% damage reduction.
desc_th: ทุกครั้งที่ใช้ฮีโร่ที่มีเพียงหนึ่งธาตุ จะได้รับลดความเสียหายเพิ่ม 2%
desc_in: Setiap kali menggunakan pahlawan dengan satu atribut, dapatkan pengurangan damage 2%.
desc_ph: Tuwing gumagamit ng bayani na may isang attribute lang, makakakuha ng 2% damage reduction.
desc_ma: Setiap kali menggunakan wira dengan satu atribut, dapatkan 2% pengurangan kerosakan.

desc: Increase control immunity rate by 30% for all our heroes.
desc_vn: Tăng 30% tỷ lệ miễn nhiễm kiểm soát cho tất cả anh hùng của chúng tôi.
desc_en: Increase control immunity rate by 30% for all our heroes.
desc_th: เพิ่มอัตราต้านทานการควบคุมของฮีโร่ทั้งหมดของเรา 30%
desc_in: Tingkatkan tingkat kekebalan terhadap kontrol sebesar 30% untuk semua pahlawan kita.
desc_ph: Dagdagan ng 30% control immunity ang lahat ng ating bayani.
desc_ma: Tingkatkan kadar imun terhadap kawalan sebanyak 30% untuk semua wira kita.

desc: Every 5% extra Defense (including from Mythic World, special combat bonuses, buffs) increases damage reflection by 5%.
desc_vn: Mỗi 5% phòng thủ thêm (bao gồm gia tăng từ Thế Giới Thần Thoại, tăng từ chiến đấu đặc biệt, buff) sẽ tăng 5% phản sát thương.
desc_en: Every 5% extra Defense (including from Mythic World, special combat bonuses, buffs) increases damage reflection by 5%.
desc_th: ทุกการเพิ่มพลังป้องกัน 5% (รวมจากโลกเทพเจ้า โบนัสการต่อสู้ บัฟ) จะเพิ่มการสะท้อนความเสียหาย 5%
desc_in: Setiap tambahan 5% Pertahanan (termasuk dari Dunia Mitos, bonus pertempuran khusus, buff) meningkatkan pantulan damage sebesar 5%.
desc_ph: Bawat dagdag na 5% defense (kasama ang mula sa Mythic World, espesyal na bonus, buff) ay magpapataas ng 5% damage reflect.
desc_ma: Setiap tambahan 5% Pertahanan (termasuk dari Dunia Mitos, bonus pertempuran khas, buff) meningkatkan pantulan kerosakan sebanyak 5%.

desc: Each time damage is dealt, gain a shield equal to 5% of the damage dealt.
desc_vn: Mỗi lần gây sát thương, sẽ nhận thêm khiên bằng 5% sát thương đã gây ra.
desc_en: Each time damage is dealt, gain a shield equal to 5% of the damage dealt.
desc_th: ทุกครั้งที่สร้างความเสียหาย จะได้รับบาเรียเท่ากับ 5% ของความเสียหายที่ทำได้
desc_in: Setiap kali memberikan damage, dapatkan perisai sebesar 5% dari damage yang diberikan.
desc_ph: Tuwing may damage, makakakuha ng shield na katumbas ng 5% ng nagawang damage.
desc_ma: Setiap kali menyebabkan kerosakan, terima perisai bersamaan dengan 5% daripada kerosakan tersebut.

desc: Each point of overhealing is converted into 2 shield points.
desc_vn: Mỗi điểm hồi phục máu dư thừa sẽ được chuyển thành 2 điểm khiên.
desc_en: Each point of overhealing is converted into 2 shield points.
desc_th: ทุกจุดการฟื้นฟู HP เกินพิกัด จะเปลี่ยนเป็นบาเรีย 2 แต้ม
desc_in: Setiap poin penyembuhan yang berlebih akan diubah menjadi 2 poin perisai.
desc_ph: Bawat sobra sa healing ay magiging 2 shield points.
desc_ma: Setiap titik pemulihan HP berlebihan akan ditukar kepada 2 mata perisai.

desc: When our first hero dies, they revive before the next action phase, restoring 50% HP and 100% energy. This effect can only occur once per battle.
desc_vn: Khi anh hùng đầu tiên của chúng tôi tử trận, sẽ hồi sinh trước khi bắt đầu lượt hành động tiếp theo, hồi phục 50% máu và 100% tức, hiệu ứng này chỉ có thể áp dụng trong một trận chiến.
desc_en: When our first hero dies, they revive before the next action phase, restoring 50% HP and 100% energy. This effect can only occur once per battle.
desc_th: เมื่อฮีโร่ตัวแรกของเราตาย จะฟื้นคืนชีพก่อนรอบถัดไป พร้อมฟื้น HP 50% และพลังงาน 100% เอฟเฟกต์นี้ใช้ได้เพียงหนึ่งครั้งต่อการต่อสู้
desc_in: Ketika pahlawan pertama kita mati, dia akan bangkit kembali sebelum giliran berikutnya, memulihkan 50% HP dan 100% energi. Efek ini hanya berlaku satu kali per pertempuran.
desc_ph: Kapag namatay ang una nating bayani, siya ay magre-resurrect bago magsimula ang susunod na aksyon, may 50% HP at 100% energy. Isang beses lang ito kada laban.
desc_ma: Apabila wira pertama kita mati, mereka akan hidup semula sebelum giliran tindakan seterusnya, memulihkan 50% HP dan 100% tenaga. Kesan ini hanya berlaku sekali setiap pertempuran.

desc: At the start of each turn, there is a 20% chance to randomly stun an enemy.
desc_vn: Mỗi lượt bắt đầu, có 20% cơ hội khiến ngẫu nhiên một kẻ địch bị choáng.
desc_en: At the start of each turn, there is a 20% chance to randomly stun an enemy.
desc_th: เมื่อเริ่มแต่ละรอบ มีโอกาส 20% ที่จะทำให้ศัตรูหนึ่งตัวติดสถานะสตันแบบสุ่ม
desc_in: Pada awal setiap giliran, ada peluang 20% untuk membuat musuh acak terkena stun.
desc_ph: Sa simula ng bawat turn, may 20% tsansa na mag-stun ng isang random na kalaban.
desc_ma: Setiap permulaan giliran, ada 20% peluang menyebabkan satu musuh rawak terkena stun.

desc: Increase control effect rate by 20% for our heroes.
desc_vn: Tăng 20% tỷ lệ kiểm soát cho anh hùng của chúng tôi.
desc_en: Increase control effect rate by 20% for our heroes.
desc_th: เพิ่มอัตราการควบคุมของฮีโร่ของเรา 20%
desc_in: Tingkatkan tingkat efek kontrol sebesar 20% untuk pahlawan kita.
desc_ph: Dagdagan ng 20% ang control chance ng ating bayani.
desc_ma: Tingkatkan kadar kawalan sebanyak 20% untuk wira kita.

desc: During the first 2 turns of battle, if the hero with the highest Physical Attack attacks, there is a 50% chance to gain an extra action.
desc_vn: Trong 2 lượt đầu trận, nếu anh hùng có tấn công vật lý cao nhất tấn công, có 50% xác suất sẽ được thêm lượt hành động.
desc_en: During the first 2 turns of battle, if the hero with the highest Physical Attack attacks, there is a 50% chance to gain an extra action.
desc_th: ใน 2 เทิร์นแรกของการต่อสู้ หากฮีโร่ที่มีพลังโจมตีกายภาพสูงสุดโจมตี จะมีโอกาส 50% ได้รับรอบการกระทำเพิ่มเติม
desc_in: Selama 2 giliran pertama, jika pahlawan dengan Serangan Fisik tertinggi menyerang, ada 50% peluang untuk mendapat giliran tambahan.
desc_ph: Sa unang 2 turn ng laban, kapag umatake ang bayani na may pinakamataas na Physical Attack, may 50% tsansa na makakuha ng dagdag na aksyon.
desc_ma: Dalam 2 giliran pertama pertempuran, jika wira dengan Serangan Fizikal tertinggi menyerang, ada 50% peluang untuk mendapat giliran tambahan.

desc: Increase damage from poison, bleeding, and burning by 10%.
desc_vn: Tăng 10% sát thương từ đầu độc, chảy máu và đốt cháy.
desc_en: Increase damage from poison, bleeding, and burning by 10%.
desc_th: เพิ่มความเสียหายจากพิษ เลือดออก และการเผาไหม้ 10%
desc_in: Tingkatkan kerusakan dari racun, pendarahan, dan terbakar sebesar 10%.
desc_ph: Dagdagan ang damage mula sa poison, bleeding, at burning ng 10%.
desc_ma: Tingkatkan kerosakan daripada racun, pendarahan dan pembakaran sebanyak 10%.

desc: At the start of the next battle, silence all enemies for 1 turn.
desc_vn: Khi trận chiến tiếp theo bắt đầu, sẽ làm im lặng tất cả kẻ địch trong 1 lượt.
desc_en: At the start of the next battle, silence all enemies for 1 turn.
desc_th: เมื่อเริ่มการต่อสู้ถัดไป จะทำให้ศัตรูทั้งหมดเงียบ 1 เทิร์น
desc_in: Saat pertempuran berikutnya dimulai, diamkan semua musuh selama 1 giliran.
desc_ph: Sa simula ng susunod na laban, paihinto ang lahat ng kalaban ng 1 turn.
desc_ma: Apabila pertempuran seterusnya bermula, senyapkan semua musuh selama 1 giliran.

desc: At the start of the next battle, all enemies will be asleep for 1 turn.
desc_vn: Khi trận chiến tiếp theo bắt đầu, tất cả kẻ địch sẽ ngủ trong 1 lượt.
desc_en: At the start of the next battle, all enemies will be asleep for 1 turn.
desc_th: เมื่อเริ่มการต่อสู้ถัดไป ศัตรูทั้งหมดจะหลับ 1 เทิร์น
desc_in: Saat pertempuran berikutnya dimulai, semua musuh akan tertidur selama 1 giliran.
desc_ph: Sa simula ng susunod na laban, lahat ng kalaban ay matutulog ng 1 turn.
desc_ma: Apabila pertempuran seterusnya bermula, semua musuh akan tidur selama 1 giliran.

desc: Upon entering battle, all heroes gain energy equal to the number of main attributes * 50.
desc_vn: Khi vào trận, tất cả anh hùng sẽ nhận thêm tức bằng số lượng thuộc tính hiện tại (chỉ tính thuộc tính chính) * 50.
desc_en: Upon entering battle, all heroes gain energy equal to the number of main attributes * 50.
desc_th: เมื่อเข้าสู่การต่อสู้ ฮีโร่ทั้งหมดจะได้รับพลังงานเท่ากับจำนวนธาตุหลัก * 50
desc_in: Saat memasuki pertempuran, semua pahlawan menerima energi sama dengan jumlah atribut utama * 50.
desc_ph: Pagpasok sa laban, lahat ng bayani ay makakatanggap ng energy base sa bilang ng pangunahing attribute * 50.
desc_ma: Apabila memasuki pertempuran, semua wira menerima tenaga bersamaan bilangan atribut utama * 50.

desc: If the team has more than 4 heroes sharing the same main attribute, at the start of battle those heroes gain an additional 500 energy.
desc_vn: Nếu trong đội hình có hơn 4 anh hùng cùng thuộc tính chính, khi bắt đầu trận chiến, anh hùng có thuộc tính đó sẽ nhận thêm 500 tức.
desc_en: If the team has more than 4 heroes sharing the same main attribute, at the start of battle those heroes gain an additional 500 energy.
desc_th: หากทีมมีฮีโร่มากกว่า 4 ตัวที่มีธาตุหลักเหมือนกัน เมื่อเริ่มการต่อสู้ ฮีโร่ที่มีธาตุนั้นจะได้รับพลังงานเพิ่ม 500
desc_in: Jika dalam tim ada lebih dari 4 pahlawan dengan atribut utama yang sama, pada awal pertempuran pahlawan dengan atribut itu menerima tambahan energi 500.
desc_ph: Kung may higit sa 4 na bayani sa team na may parehong pangunahing attribute, sa simula ng laban ang mga bayani na iyon ay makakatanggap ng dagdag na 500 energy.
desc_ma: Jika pasukan mempunyai lebih daripada 4 wira dengan atribut utama yang sama, pada permulaan pertempuran wira dengan atribut tersebut akan menerima tambahan 500 tenaga.

desc: When HP falls below 40%, energy recovery effects are doubled.
desc_vn: Khi máu giảm xuống dưới 40%, hiệu quả hồi phục tức sẽ được nhân đôi.
desc_en: When HP falls below 40%, energy recovery effects are doubled.
desc_th: เมื่อ HP ต่ำกว่า 40% ผลฟื้นฟูพลังงานจะเพิ่มเป็นสองเท่า
desc_in: Saat HP turun di bawah 40%, efek pemulihan energi digandakan.
desc_ph: Kapag bumaba ang HP ng bayani sa ilalim ng 40%, ang energy recovery effect ay dodoble.
desc_ma: Apabila HP jatuh di bawah 40%, kesan pemulihan tenaga berganda.

desc: In the next battle, our heroes start with 1000 energy.
desc_vn: Trong trận chiến tiếp theo, anh hùng của chúng tôi sẽ nhận 1000 tức ban đầu.
desc_en: In the next battle, our heroes start with 1000 energy.
desc_th: ในการต่อสู้ถัดไป ฮีโร่ของเราจะเริ่มต้นด้วยพลังงาน 1000
desc_in: Dalam pertempuran berikutnya, pahlawan kita memulai dengan 1000 energi.
desc_ph: Sa susunod na laban, magsisimula ang mga bayani natin na may 1000 energy.
desc_ma: Dalam pertempuran seterusnya, wira kita bermula dengan 1000 tenaga.

desc: At the start of the battle, our heroes gain a shield equal to the amount of lost HP, lasting 2 turns.
desc_vn: Khi trận đấu bắt đầu, anh hùng của chúng tôi sẽ nhận một lớp khiên bằng với lượng máu đã mất, kéo dài 2 lượt.
desc_en: At the start of the battle, our heroes gain a shield equal to the amount of lost HP, lasting 2 turns.
desc_th: เมื่อเริ่มการต่อสู้ ฮีโร่ของเราจะได้รับบาเรียเท่ากับจำนวน HP ที่เสียไป เป็นเวลา 2 เทิร์น
desc_in: Saat pertempuran dimulai, pahlawan kita mendapatkan perisai sebesar jumlah HP yang hilang, bertahan 2 giliran.
desc_ph: Sa simula ng laban, magkakaroon ang mga bayani ng shield na katumbas ng nawalang HP, tatagal ng 2 turns.
desc_ma: Pada permulaan pertempuran, wira kita menerima perisai bersamaan dengan jumlah HP yang hilang, bertahan 2 giliran.

desc: Each time our heroes lose 10% HP, they gain 8% damage reduction, effective only for the first turn.
desc_vn: Mỗi khi anh hùng của chúng tôi mất 10% máu, sẽ nhận thêm 8% giảm sát thương, hiệu ứng này chỉ có hiệu lực trong lượt đầu tiên.
desc_en: Each time our heroes lose 10% HP, they gain 8% damage reduction, effective only for the first turn.
desc_th: ทุกครั้งที่ฮีโร่ของเราเสีย HP 10% จะได้รับการลดความเสียหาย 8% โดยมีผลเฉพาะเทิร์นแรกเท่านั้น
desc_in: Setiap kali pahlawan kita kehilangan 10% HP, mereka mendapatkan 8% pengurangan kerusakan, hanya berlaku pada giliran pertama.
desc_ph: Tuwing mawawala ang 10% HP ng bayani, makakakuha siya ng 8% damage reduction na epektibo lamang sa unang turn.
desc_ma: Setiap kali wira kita kehilangan 10% HP, mereka mendapat pengurangan kerosakan sebanyak 8%, hanya berkesan untuk giliran pertama.

desc: On the second turn of the battle, all enemy energy is cleared.
desc_vn: Vào lượt thứ hai của trận đấu, sẽ xóa toàn bộ tức của tất cả kẻ địch.
desc_en: On the second turn of the battle, all enemy energy is cleared.
desc_th: ในเทิร์นที่สองของการต่อสู้ พลังงานของศัตรูทั้งหมดจะถูกล้าง
desc_in: Pada giliran kedua pertempuran, semua energi musuh dibersihkan.
desc_ph: Sa ikalawang turn ng laban, mawawala ang lahat ng energy ng kalaban.
desc_ma: Pada giliran kedua pertempuran, semua tenaga musuh dibersihkan.

desc: When a hero in our team dies, the remaining heroes recover 20% max HP and gain 500 energy.
desc_vn: Khi một anh hùng trong đội chúng tôi tử trận, các anh hùng còn lại sẽ hồi phục 20% máu tối đa và nhận 500 tức.
desc_en: When a hero in our team dies, the remaining heroes recover 20% max HP and gain 500 energy.
desc_th: เมื่อฮีโร่ในทีมเราตาย ฮีโร่ที่เหลือจะฟื้นฟู HP สูงสุด 20% และได้รับพลังงาน 500
desc_in: Ketika seorang pahlawan dalam tim kita mati, pahlawan yang tersisa memulihkan 20% HP maksimum dan mendapat 500 energi.
desc_ph: Kapag namatay ang isang bayani sa team, ang natitirang bayani ay magre-recover ng 20% max HP at makakakuha ng 500 energy.
desc_ma: Apabila seorang wira dalam pasukan kita mati, wira yang tinggal akan pulih 20% HP maksimum dan menerima 500 tenaga.

desc: At the end of our heroes’ turns, recover 15% of lost HP.
desc_vn: Cuối lượt của anh hùng trong đội chúng tôi, sẽ hồi phục 15% lượng máu đã mất.
desc_en: At the end of our heroes’ turns, recover 15% of lost HP.
desc_th: เมื่อจบเทิร์นของฮีโร่ในทีม เราจะฟื้นฟู HP ที่เสียไป 15%
desc_in: Di akhir giliran pahlawan kita, pulihkan 15% HP yang hilang.
desc_ph: Sa pagtatapos ng turn ng mga bayani natin, magre-recover ng 15% ng nawalang HP.
desc_ma: Pada akhir giliran wira kita, pulihkan 15% HP yang hilang.

desc: When using ultimate skill, our heroes have a 10% chance to instantly recover 100% energy.
desc_vn: Khi sử dụng tuyệt chiêu, anh hùng của chúng tôi có 10% xác suất hồi phục ngay lập tức 100% tức.
desc_en: When using ultimate skill, our heroes have a 10% chance to instantly recover 100% energy.
desc_th: เมื่อใช้สกิลอัลติเมท ฮีโร่ของเรามีโอกาส 10% ฟื้นฟูพลังงานทันที 100%
desc_in: Saat menggunakan skill ultimate, pahlawan kita memiliki peluang 10% untuk langsung memulihkan 100% energi.
desc_ph: Kapag gumamit ng ultimate skill, may 10% chance ang bayani natin na makakuha agad ng 100% energy.
desc_ma: Apabila menggunakan kemahiran ultimate, wira kita mempunyai peluang 10% untuk pulih serta-merta 100% tenaga.

desc: At the start of each turn, randomly mark one enemy to receive 50% increased damage.
desc_vn: Mỗi lượt bắt đầu, đánh dấu ngẫu nhiên một kẻ địch, khiến nó nhận thêm 50% sát thương.
desc_en: At the start of each turn, randomly mark one enemy to receive 50% increased damage.
desc_th: เมื่อเริ่มแต่ละเทิร์น จะสุ่มทำเครื่องหมายศัตรูหนึ่งตัวให้ได้รับความเสียหายเพิ่มขึ้น 50%
desc_in: Pada awal setiap giliran, tandai satu musuh secara acak untuk menerima 50% kerusakan tambahan.
desc_ph: Sa simula ng bawat turn, random na mamarkahan ang isang kalaban para makatanggap ng 50% dagdag damage.
desc_ma: Pada permulaan setiap giliran, tandakan secara rawak seorang musuh untuk menerima peningkatan kerosakan sebanyak 50%.

desc: After using ultimate skill, our heroes gain 20% speed and 200 energy.
desc_vn: Sau khi sử dụng tuyệt chiêu, anh hùng của chúng tôi sẽ tăng 20% tốc độ và nhận thêm 200 tức.
desc_en: After using ultimate skill, our heroes gain 20% speed and 200 energy.
desc_th: หลังจากใช้สกิลอัลติเมท ฮีโร่ของเราจะได้รับความเร็วเพิ่ม 20% และได้รับพลังงาน 200
desc_in: Setelah menggunakan skill ultimate, pahlawan kita mendapat tambahan 20% kecepatan dan 200 energi.
desc_ph: Pagkatapos gumamit ng ultimate skill, tataas ng 20% ang speed ng bayani at makakakuha ng 200 energy.
desc_ma: Selepas menggunakan kemahiran ultimate, wira kita menerima peningkatan kelajuan sebanyak 20% dan tambahan 200 tenaga.

desc: Our heroes’ attribute counter effects are strengthened, dealing 20% additional damage to heroes with countered attributes.
desc_vn: Hiệu quả khắc chế thuộc tính của anh hùng của chúng tôi được tăng cường, gây thêm 20% sát thương đối với các anh hùng thuộc thuộc tính bị khắc chế.
desc_en: Our heroes’ attribute counter effects are strengthened, dealing 20% additional damage to heroes with countered attributes.
desc_th: ผลกระทบการชนะธาตุของฮีโร่เราได้รับการเสริมแรง ทำความเสียหายเพิ่มเติม 20% ต่อฮีโร่ที่ถูกชนะธาตุ
desc_in: Efek counter atribut pahlawan kita diperkuat, memberikan tambahan 20% kerusakan pada pahlawan dengan atribut yang terkena counter.
desc_ph: Pinatibay ang counter attribute effect ng bayani natin, magdudulot ng 20% dagdag damage laban sa mga bayani na na-counter ang attribute.
desc_ma: Kesan counter atribut wira kita dipertingkatkan, menyebabkan 20% kerosakan tambahan kepada wira dengan atribut yang di-counter.

desc: When our hero defeats an enemy, they recover 10% HP and gain 200 energy.
desc_vn: Khi anh hùng của chúng tôi tiêu diệt một kẻ địch, sẽ hồi phục 10% máu và 200 tức.
desc_en: When our hero defeats an enemy, they recover 10% HP and gain 200 energy.
desc_th: เมื่อฮีโร่ของเรากำจัดศัตรู จะฟื้นฟู HP 10% และได้รับพลังงาน 200
desc_in: Saat pahlawan kita mengalahkan musuh, mereka memulihkan 10% HP dan mendapatkan 200 energi
desc_ph: Kapag nakapatay ang bayani natin ng kalaban, magre-recover siya ng 10% HP at makakakuha ng 200 energy
desc_ma: Apabila wira kita membunuh musuh, mereka akan memulihkan 10% HP dan menerima 200 tenaga

desc: At the end of each full round, enemies with less than 10% HP will be reaped by the death god Yveltal and instantly removed from battle.
desc_vn: Cuối mỗi lượt lớn, các kẻ địch có máu dưới 10% sẽ bị thần chết Yveltal thu thập, trực tiếp bị loại bỏ khỏi trận đấu.
desc_en: At the end of each full round, enemies with less than 10% HP will be reaped by the death god Yveltal and instantly removed from battle.
desc_th: เมื่อสิ้นสุดแต่ละรอบใหญ่ ศัตรูที่มี HP ต่ำกว่า 10% จะถูกยมทูต Yveltal เก็บเกี่ยวและถูกกำจัดออกจากการต่อสู้ทันที
desc_in: Di akhir setiap ronde penuh, musuh dengan kurang dari 10% HP akan dikumpulkan oleh dewa kematian Yveltal dan langsung dikeluarkan dari pertempuran
desc_ph: Sa pagtatapos ng bawat buong round, ang mga kalaban na may HP na mas mababa sa 10% ay kukunin ni kamatayan Yveltal at agad na matatanggal sa laban
desc_ma: Pada akhir setiap pusingan penuh, musuh yang mempunyai kurang daripada 10% HP akan dikutip oleh dewa kematian Yveltal dan terus disingkirkan dari pertempuran

desc: In the first turn of battle, our entire team gains 20% speed.
desc_vn: Trong lượt đầu tiên của trận đấu, toàn đội chúng tôi được tăng 20% tốc độ.
desc_en: In the first turn of battle, our entire team gains 20% speed.
desc_th: ในเทิร์นแรกของการต่อสู้ ทีมของเราจะได้รับความเร็วเพิ่มขึ้น 20%
desc_in: Pada giliran pertama pertempuran, seluruh tim kita mendapatkan 20% kecepatan
desc_ph: Sa unang turn ng laban, ang buong team natin ay makakakuha ng 20% dagdag speed
desc_ma: Dalam giliran pertama pertempuran, seluruh pasukan kita mendapat 20% kelajuan

desc: Increase our heroes' speed by 4% for each main attribute present.
desc_vn: Tăng 4% tốc độ cho anh hùng của chúng tôi theo số lượng thuộc tính (chỉ tính thuộc tính chính).
desc_en: Increase our heroes' speed by 4% for each main attribute present.
desc_th: เพิ่มความเร็วของฮีโร่ของเราขึ้น 4% ตามจำนวนธาตุหลักที่มีอยู่
desc_in: Tingkatkan kecepatan pahlawan kita sebesar 4% untuk setiap atribut utama yang ada
desc_ph: Tumataas ang speed ng mga bayani natin ng 4% depende sa bilang ng pangunahing attribute
desc_ma: Tingkatkan kelajuan wira kita sebanyak 4% berdasarkan jumlah atribut utama yang ada

desc: Frontline heroes have a 50% chance to be immune to control effects.
desc_vn: Anh hùng ở tuyến trước của chúng tôi có 50% xác suất miễn nhiễm với các hiệu ứng kiểm soát.
desc_en: Frontline heroes have a 50% chance to be immune to control effects.
desc_th: ฮีโร่แนวหน้ามีโอกาส 50% ที่จะต้านทานเอฟเฟกต์ควบคุม
desc_in: Pahlawan di garis depan memiliki 50% peluang kebal terhadap efek kontrol
desc_ph: May 50% chance ang mga bayani sa frontline na immune sa control effects
desc_ma: Wira barisan hadapan mempunyai 50% peluang untuk kebal daripada kesan kawalan

desc: Enemies permanently lose 10% of their max HP.
desc_vn: Kẻ địch sẽ giảm vĩnh viễn 10% máu tối đa.
desc_en: Enemies permanently lose 10% of their max HP.
desc_th: ศัตรูจะสูญเสีย HP สูงสุดถาวร 10%
desc_in: Musuh akan kehilangan 10% HP maksimum secara permanen
desc_ph: Ang mga kalaban ay permanenteng mababawasan ng 10% max HP
desc_ma: Musuh akan kehilangan 10% HP maksimum secara kekal

desc: When our hero is defeated, the attacker takes damage equal to the damage dealt by our hero.
desc_vn: Khi anh hùng của chúng tôi bị đánh bại, kẻ gây sát thương sẽ nhận sát thương bằng lượng sát thương mà anh hùng của chúng tôi gây ra.
desc_en: When our hero is defeated, the attacker takes damage equal to the damage dealt by our hero.
desc_th: เมื่อฮีโร่ของเราถูกสังหาร ศัตรูที่โจมตีจะได้รับความเสียหายเท่ากับความเสียหายที่ฮีโร่ของเราสร้างไว้
desc_in: Saat pahlawan kita terbunuh, penyerang akan menerima kerusakan setara dengan jumlah kerusakan yang telah ditimbulkan oleh pahlawan tersebut
desc_ph: Kapag namatay ang bayani natin, ang kalabang pumatay ay tatanggap ng damage na katumbas ng damage na nagawa ng bayani natin
desc_ma: Apabila wira kita dikalahkan, penyerang akan menerima kerosakan bersamaan dengan jumlah kerosakan yang telah dilakukan oleh wira tersebut

desc: When killing an enemy, deal an additional 40% of that damage to surrounding heroes.
desc_vn: Khi tiêu diệt kẻ địch, sẽ gây thêm 40% sát thương của sát thương đó lên các anh hùng xung quanh.
desc_en: When killing an enemy, deal an additional 40% of that damage to surrounding heroes.
desc_th: เมื่อกำจัดศัตรู จะสร้างความเสียหายเพิ่มเติม 40% ของความเสียหายนั้นแก่ฮีโร่รอบข้าง
desc_in: Saat membunuh musuh, berikan tambahan 40% dari kerusakan itu ke pahlawan musuh di sekitarnya
desc_ph: Kapag nakapatay ng kalaban, magdudulot ng karagdagang 40% damage ng orihinal na damage sa mga kalabang nasa paligid
desc_ma: Apabila membunuh musuh, akan menyebabkan 40% kerosakan tambahan daripada kerosakan asal kepada wira musuh berdekatan

desc: When attacking, our heroes have a 20% chance to steal 50 energy from the target.
desc_vn: Khi tấn công, anh hùng của chúng tôi có 20% xác suất cướp 50 tức của mục tiêu.
desc_en: When attacking, our heroes have a 20% chance to steal 50 energy from the target.
desc_th: เมื่อโจมตี ฮีโร่ของเรามีโอกาส 20% ขโมยพลังงาน 50 จากเป้าหมาย
desc_in: Saat menyerang, pahlawan kita memiliki peluang 20% mencuri 50 energi dari target
desc_ph: Kapag umatake, may 20% chance ang bayani natin na manakaw ang 50 energy ng target
desc_ma: Apabila menyerang, wira kita mempunyai 20% peluang untuk mencuri 50 tenaga daripada sasaran

desc: Our heroes’ healing effect is increased by 30%.
desc_vn: Tỷ lệ hồi phục của anh hùng của chúng tôi được tăng 30%.
desc_en: Our heroes’ healing effect is increased by 30%.
desc_th: อัตราการฟื้นฟูของฮีโร่ของเราเพิ่มขึ้น 30%
desc_in: Efek penyembuhan pahlawan kita meningkat 30%
desc_ph: Tumaas ng 30% ang healing effect ng bayani natin
desc_ma: Kesan pemulihan wira kita meningkat sebanyak 30%

desc: When using ultimate skill, our hero will remove all buffs from the target.
desc_vn: Khi sử dụng tuyệt chiêu, anh hùng của chúng tôi sẽ xóa tất cả các hiệu ứng buff trên mục tiêu.
desc_en: When using ultimate skill, our hero will remove all buffs from the target.
desc_th: เมื่อใช้สกิลอัลติเมท ฮีโร่ของเราจะลบทุกบัฟของเป้าหมาย
desc_in: Saat menggunakan skill ultimate, pahlawan kita akan menghapus semua buff dari target
desc_ph: Kapag gumamit ng ultimate skill, aalisin ng bayani natin ang lahat ng buff ng kalaban
desc_ma: Apabila menggunakan kemahiran ultimate, wira kita akan menghapuskan semua buff pada sasaran

desc: On odd-numbered turns, our heroes deal 30% more ultimate damage; on even-numbered turns, ultimate damage is reduced by 15%.
desc_vn: Trong các lượt lẻ, anh hùng của chúng tôi sẽ tăng 30% sát thương tuyệt chiêu, trong các lượt chẵn, giảm 15% sát thương tuyệt chiêu.
desc_en: On odd-numbered turns, our heroes deal 30% more ultimate damage; on even-numbered turns, ultimate damage is reduced by 15%.
desc_th: ในเทิร์นเลขคี่ ฮีโร่ของเราจะเพิ่มความเสียหายของสกิลอัลติเมท 30% ในเทิร์นเลขคู่ จะลดลง 15%
desc_in: Pada giliran ganjil, pahlawan kita memberikan 30% lebih banyak kerusakan ultimate; pada giliran genap, kerusakan ultimate berkurang 15%
desc_ph: Sa mga odd-numbered turns, tataas ng 30% ang ultimate damage ng bayani natin; sa even-numbered turns, bababa ng 15%
desc_ma: Pada giliran ganjil, wira kita akan meningkatkan 30% kerosakan ultimate; pada giliran genap, kerosakan ultimate dikurangkan sebanyak 15%

desc: At the end of each full round, deal true damage equal to 20% of the highest damage dealt by a hero on our team to all enemies.
desc_vn: Cuối mỗi lượt lớn, sẽ gây sát thương thật bằng 20% sát thương cao nhất của anh hùng trong đội chúng tôi lên tất cả kẻ địch.
desc_en: At the end of each full round, deal true damage equal to 20% of the highest damage dealt by a hero on our team to all enemies.
desc_th: เมื่อสิ้นสุดแต่ละรอบใหญ่ จะสร้างความเสียหายจริงเท่ากับ 20% ของความเสียหายสูงสุดจากฮีโร่ในทีมเราต่อศัตรูทั้งหมด
desc_in: Di akhir setiap ronde penuh, berikan true damage sebesar 20% dari kerusakan tertinggi yang dihasilkan oleh pahlawan tim kita kepada semua musuh
desc_ph: Sa pagtatapos ng bawat buong round, magdudulot ng totoong damage na katumbas ng 20% ng pinakamataas na damage ng isang bayani natin sa lahat ng kalaban
desc_ma: Pada akhir setiap pusingan penuh, berikan kerosakan sebenar sebanyak 20% daripada kerosakan tertinggi oleh wira kita kepada semua musuh

desc: At the start of battle, all heroes gain a team-wide shield that absorbs all incoming damage, with the value equal to the max HP of the hero with the highest HP.
desc_vn: Khi vào trận, tất cả anh hùng sẽ nhận một lớp khiên toàn đội, lớp khiên này có thể hấp thụ tất cả sát thương nhận vào, giá trị hấp thụ bằng máu tối đa của anh hùng có máu cao nhất.
desc_en: At the start of battle, all heroes gain a team-wide shield that absorbs all incoming damage, with the value equal to the max HP of the hero with the highest HP.
desc_th: เมื่อเข้าสู่การต่อสู้ ฮีโร่ทั้งหมดจะได้รับโล่ทีมที่สามารถดูดซับความเสียหายทั้งหมด โดยมูลค่าโล่เท่ากับ HP สูงสุดของฮีโร่ที่มี HP สูงสุด
desc_in: Saat pertempuran dimulai, semua pahlawan mendapatkan perisai tim yang menyerap semua kerusakan, bernilai sama dengan HP maksimum dari pahlawan dengan HP tertinggi
desc_ph: Sa simula ng laban, ang lahat ng bayani natin ay makakatanggap ng team shield na kayang sumalo ng lahat ng damage, na may halaga katumbas ng max HP ng bayani na may pinakamataas na HP
desc_ma: Apabila pertempuran bermula, semua wira akan menerima perisai pasukan yang boleh menyerap semua kerosakan, dengan nilai bersamaan HP maksimum wira yang mempunyai HP tertinggi

desc: Damage-over-time effects dealt by our heroes are doubled.
desc_vn: Sát thương duy trì mà anh hùng của chúng tôi gây ra sẽ được tăng gấp đôi.
desc_en: Damage-over-time effects dealt by our heroes are doubled.
desc_th: เอฟเฟกต์ความเสียหายต่อเนื่องจากฮีโร่ของเราจะเพิ่มเป็นสองเท่า
desc_in: Efek damage over time dari pahlawan kita menjadi dua kali lipat
desc_ph: Ang lahat ng damage-over-time ng bayani natin ay dodoble
desc_ma: Kesan kerosakan berterusan daripada wira kita akan digandakan

desc: In the first turn of battle, our heroes start with full energy, but ultimate skill damage is reduced by 20% during that turn.
desc_vn: Trong lượt đầu tiên của trận đấu, anh hùng của chúng tôi sẽ có đầy đủ tức, nhưng sát thương tuyệt chiêu sẽ giảm 20% trong lượt đó.
desc_en: In the first turn of battle, our heroes start with full energy, but ultimate skill damage is reduced by 20% during that turn.
desc_th: ในเทิร์นแรกของการต่อสู้ ฮีโร่ของเราจะเริ่มด้วยพลังงานเต็ม แต่ความเสียหายจากสกิลอัลติเมทจะลดลง 20% ในเทิร์นนั้น
desc_in: Pada giliran pertama pertempuran, pahlawan kita mulai dengan energi penuh, namun damage ultimate akan berkurang 20% pada giliran itu
desc_ph: Sa unang turn ng laban, magsisimula ang bayani natin na may full energy, ngunit bababa ng 20% ang ultimate damage sa turn na iyon
desc_ma: Dalam giliran pertama pertempuran, wira kita akan bermula dengan tenaga penuh tetapi kerosakan ultimate dikurangkan sebanyak 20% dalam giliran itu

desc: <Fire Force>: Each time dealing damage to an enemy, reduce their double damage by 8%, up to a maximum of 10% of the user's own value (<Dark Force> enhances this effect)
desc_vn: <Hỏa chi lực>: Mỗi lần gây sát thương cho kẻ địch, giảm 8% sát thương đôi của nó, tối đa không quá 10% của bản thân (<Ác chi lực> sẽ tăng cường hiệu ứng bổ sung)
desc_en: <Fire Force>: Each time dealing damage to an enemy, reduce their double damage by 8%, up to a maximum of 10% of the user's own value (<Dark Force> enhances this effect)
desc_th: <พลังไฟ>: ทุกครั้งที่สร้างความเสียหายให้ศัตรู ลดความเสียหายคู่ของศัตรูลง 8% สูงสุดไม่เกิน 10% ของค่าของตัวเอง (<พลังมืด> จะเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพเพิ่มเติม)
desc_in: <Kekuatan Api>: Setiap kali menyerang musuh, kurangi 8% damage ganda musuh, maksimal tidak lebih dari 10% dari nilai pengguna (<Kekuatan Gelap> meningkatkan efek ini)
desc_ph: <Lakas ng Apoy>: Sa bawat pag-atake sa kalaban, bawasan ang kanilang double damage ng 8%, hanggang sa maximum na 10% ng sariling halaga (<Lakas ng Kadiliman> nagpapahusay sa epektong ito)
desc_ma: <Kekuatan Api>: Setiap kali menyerang musuh, kurangkan 8% kerosakan berganda mereka, maksimum tidak melebihi 10% nilai sendiri (<Kekuatan Gelap> meningkatkan kesan ini)

desc: <Water Force>: Each time dealing damage to an enemy, reduce their double defense by 8%, up to a maximum of 10% of the user's own value (<Dark Force> enhances this effect)
desc_vn: <Thủy chi lực>: Mỗi lần gây sát thương cho kẻ địch, giảm 8% phòng thủ đôi của nó, tối đa không quá 10% của bản thân (<Ác chi lực> sẽ tăng cường hiệu ứng bổ sung)
desc_en: <Water Force>: Each time dealing damage to an enemy, reduce their double defense by 8%, up to a maximum of 10% of the user's own value (<Dark Force> enhances this effect)
desc_th: <พลังน้ำ>: ทุกครั้งที่สร้างความเสียหายให้ศัตรู ลดการป้องกันคู่ของศัตรูลง 8% สูงสุดไม่เกิน 10% ของค่าของตัวเอง (<พลังมืด> จะเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพเพิ่มเติม)
desc_in: <Kekuatan Air>: Setiap kali menyerang musuh, kurangi 8% pertahanan ganda musuh, maksimal tidak lebih dari 10% dari nilai pengguna (<Kekuatan Gelap> meningkatkan efek ini)
desc_ph: <Lakas ng Tubig>: Sa bawat pag-atake sa kalaban, bawasan ang kanilang double defense ng 8%, hanggang sa maximum na 10% ng sariling halaga (<Lakas ng Kadiliman> nagpapahusay sa epektong ito)
desc_ma: <Kekuatan Air>: Setiap kali menyerang musuh, kurangkan 8% pertahanan berganda musuh, maksimum tidak melebihi 10% nilai sendiri (<Kekuatan Gelap> meningkatkan kesan ini)

desc: <Dark Force>: Enhances <Fire Force> and <Water Force>: When attacking and reducing double damage and double defense of the target, converts corresponding attribute amounts to the attacker; also with <Dark Force>, <Fire Force>, <Water Force>, the whole team gains 10% lifesteal
desc_vn: <Ác chi lực>: Tăng cường hiệu quả của <Hỏa chi lực><Thủy chi lực>: Khi tấn công và giảm sát thương đôi và phòng thủ đôi của mục tiêu, sẽ chuyển đổi số lượng thuộc tính tương ứng cho người tấn công, đồng thời có <Ác chi lực><Hỏa chi lực><Thủy chi lực>, toàn bộ đội ngũ của chúng tôi nhận thêm 10% hút máu
desc_en: <Dark Force>: Enhances <Fire Force> and <Water Force>: When attacking and reducing double damage and double defense of the target, converts corresponding attribute amounts to the attacker; also with <Dark Force>, <Fire Force>, <Water Force>, the whole team gains 10% lifesteal
desc_th: <พลังมืด>: เพิ่มประสิทธิภาพของ <พลังไฟ> และ <พลังน้ำ>: เมื่อโจมตีและลดความเสียหายคู่และการป้องกันคู่ของเป้าหมาย จะเปลี่ยนแปลงจำนวนค่าคุณลักษณะที่เกี่ยวข้องให้ผู้โจมตี และด้วย <พลังมืด><พลังไฟ><พลังน้ำ> ทีมทั้งหมดจะได้รับการดูดเลือดเพิ่ม 10%
desc_in: <Kekuatan Gelap>: Meningkatkan <Kekuatan Api> dan <Kekuatan Air>: Saat menyerang dan mengurangi damage ganda dan pertahanan ganda target, mengubah atribut yang sesuai ke penyerang; juga dengan <Kekuatan Gelap>, <Kekuatan Api>, <Kekuatan Air>, seluruh tim mendapat lifesteal 10%
desc_ph: <Lakas ng Kadiliman>: Pinapalakas ang <Lakas ng Apoy> at <Lakas ng Tubig>: Kapag umaatake at nagpapababa ng double damage at double defense ng target, kinokonvert ang kaukulang katangian sa umaatake; pati na rin sa <Lakas ng Kadiliman>, <Lakas ng Apoy>, <Lakas ng Tubig>, buong koponan ay nakakakuha ng 10% lifesteal
desc_ma: <Kekuatan Gelap>: Meningkatkan <Kekuatan Api> dan <Kekuatan Air>: Apabila menyerang dan mengurangkan kerosakan berganda dan pertahanan berganda sasaran, menukarkan atribut yang sepadan kepada penyerang; juga dengan <Kekuatan Gelap>, <Kekuatan Api>, <Kekuatan Air>, seluruh pasukan mendapat 10% lifesteal

desc: <Sunstone>: Before starting the action turn, recover 200 energy points (If combined with <Moonstone>, energy recovery speed increases by 30%)
desc_vn: <Nhật chi thạch>: Trước khi bắt đầu lượt hành động, hồi phục 200 điểm tức (Nếu có <Nhật Nguyệt chi thạch>, tốc độ hồi tức tăng 30%)
desc_en: <Sunstone>: Before starting the action turn, recover 200 energy points (If combined with <Moonstone>, energy recovery speed increases by 30%)
desc_th: <หินพระอาทิตย์>: ก่อนเริ่มต้นรอบการกระทำ ฟื้นฟูพลังงาน 200 จุด (ถ้ามี <หินพระจันทร์> จะเพิ่มความเร็วฟื้นฟูพลังงานขึ้น 30%)
desc_in: <Batu Matahari>: Sebelum memulai giliran aksi, pulihkan 200 poin energi (Jika digabung dengan <Batu Bulan>, kecepatan pemulihan energi meningkat 30%)
desc_ph: <Bato ng Araw>: Bago magsimula ang turn ng aksyon, bumalik ng 200 energy points (Kung may <Bato ng Buwan>, bumibilis ang pag-recover ng energy ng 30%)
desc_ma: <Batu Matahari>: Sebelum memulakan giliran tindakan, pulihkan 200 mata tenaga (Jika digabungkan dengan <Batu Bulan>, kelajuan pemulihan tenaga meningkat 30%)

desc: <Moonstone>: After finishing the big turn, recover 10% of lost health (If combined with <Sunstone>, energy recovery speed increases by 30%)
desc_vn: <Nguyệt chi thạch>: Sau khi kết thúc lượt lớn, hồi phục 10% máu đã mất của bản thân (Nếu có <Nhật Nguyệt chi thạch>, tốc độ hồi tức tăng 30%)
desc_en: <Moonstone>: After finishing the big turn, recover 10% of lost health (If combined with <Sunstone>, energy recovery speed increases by 30%)
desc_th: <หินพระจันทร์>: หลังจากจบรอบใหญ่ ฟื้นฟูเลือดที่หายไป 10% ของตัวเอง (ถ้ามี <หินพระอาทิตย์> จะเพิ่มความเร็วฟื้นฟูพลังงานขึ้น 30%)
desc_in: <Batu Bulan>: Setelah menyelesaikan giliran besar, pulihkan 10% HP yang hilang (Jika digabung dengan <Batu Matahari>, kecepatan pemulihan energi meningkat 30%)
desc_ph: <Bato ng Buwan>: Pagkatapos ng malaking turn, mag-recover ng 10% ng nawalang HP (Kung may <Bato ng Araw>, bumibilis ang pag-recover ng energy ng 30%)
desc_ma: <Batu Bulan>: Selepas tamat giliran besar, pulihkan 10% HP yang hilang (Jika digabungkan dengan <Batu Matahari>, kelajuan pemulihan tenaga meningkat 30%)

desc: <Rage Fire>: At the start of battle, all allies receive 100 energy points (Other effects like <Enrage, Fury, Rage Level, Rage Trigger, Berserk> each increase energy by 100 points)
desc_vn: <Nộ hỏa>: Khi bắt đầu trận đấu, toàn bộ đồng minh sẽ nhận 100 điểm tức (Các hiệu ứng khác như <Diễn nộ, Nộ kích, Cấp nộ, Kích nộ, Bạo nộ> mỗi hiệu ứng sẽ nâng cao 100 điểm tức)
desc_en: <Rage Fire>: At the start of battle, all allies receive 100 energy points (Other effects like <Enrage, Fury, Rage Level, Rage Trigger, Berserk> each increase energy by 100 points)
desc_th: <ไฟโกรธ>: เมื่อเริ่มต้นการต่อสู้ เพื่อนร่วมทีมทั้งหมดได้รับพลังงาน 100 จุด (ผลอื่น ๆ เช่น <โกรธจัด, โกรธรุนแรง, ระดับโกรธ, จุดกระตุ้นโกรธ, บ้าคลั่ง> แต่ละอย่างจะเพิ่มพลังงานอีก 100 จุด)
desc_in: <Amarah Api>: Pada awal pertempuran, seluruh sekutu mendapat 100 poin energi (Efek lain seperti <Marah, Amarah, Level Amarah, Pemicu Amarah, Kegilaan> masing-masing menambah 100 poin energi)
desc_ph: <Galit ng Apoy>: Sa simula ng laban, lahat ng kakampi ay nakakakuha ng 100 energy points (Ibang epekto tulad ng <Galit, Poot, Antas ng Galit, Trigger ng Galit, Berserk> bawat isa ay nagdadagdag ng 100 energy points)
desc_ma: <Amarah Api>: Pada permulaan pertempuran, semua sekutu mendapat 100 mata tenaga (Kesan lain seperti <Amarah, Kemarahan, Tahap Amarah, Pencetus Amarah, Kegilaan> masing-masing menambah 100 mata tenaga)

desc: <Enrage>: When receiving damage, gain 100 energy points (Can increase energy for <Rage Fire>)
desc_vn: <Diễn nộ>: Khi nhận sát thương, nhận 100 điểm tức (Có thể nâng cao điểm tức cho <Nộ hỏa>)
desc_en: <Enrage>: When receiving damage, gain 100 energy points (Can increase energy for <Rage Fire>)
desc_th: <โกรธจัด>: เมื่อได้รับความเสียหาย จะได้รับพลังงาน 100 จุด (สามารถเพิ่มพลังงานสำหรับ <ไฟโกรธ>)
desc_in: <Marah>: Saat menerima damage, dapatkan 100 poin energi (Dapat meningkatkan energi untuk <Amarah Api>)
desc_ph: <Galit>: Kapag tumanggap ng damage, makakakuha ng 100 energy points (Puwedeng magdagdag ng energy para sa <Galit ng Apoy>)
desc_ma: <Amarah>: Apabila menerima kerosakan, dapatkan 100 mata tenaga (Boleh meningkatkan tenaga untuk <Amarah Api>)

desc: <Fury>: When our hero kills an enemy, recover 10% of own health and 200 energy points (Can increase energy for <Rage Fire>)
desc_vn: <Nộ kích>: Khi anh hùng của chúng tôi tiêu diệt kẻ địch, hồi phục 10% máu bản thân và 200 điểm tức (Có thể nâng cao điểm tức cho <Nộ hỏa>)
desc_en: <Fury>: When our hero kills an enemy, recover 10% of own health and 200 energy points (Can increase energy for <Rage Fire>)
desc_th: <โกรธรุนแรง>: เมื่อฮีโร่ของเราฆ่าศัตรู ฟื้นฟูเลือด 10% ของตัวเองและพลังงาน 200 จุด (สามารถเพิ่มพลังงานสำหรับ <ไฟโกรธ>)
desc_in: <Amarah>: Saat pahlawan kami membunuh musuh, pulihkan 10% HP dan 200 poin energi (Dapat meningkatkan energi untuk <Amarah Api>)
desc_ph: <Poot>: Kapag ang aming bayani ay pumatay ng kalaban, mag-recover ng 10% ng sariling HP at 200 energy points (Puwedeng magdagdag ng energy para sa <Galit ng Apoy>)
desc_ma: <Kemarahan>: Apabila wira kami membunuh musuh, pulihkan 10% HP dan 200 mata tenaga (Boleh meningkatkan tenaga untuk <Amarah Api>)

desc: <Rage Level>: When our hero attacks, 30% chance to steal 100 energy points from the target (Can increase energy for <Rage Fire>)
desc_vn: <Cấp nộ>: Khi anh hùng của chúng tôi tấn công, có 30% khả năng cướp đi 100 điểm tức từ mục tiêu (Có thể nâng cao điểm tức cho <Nộ hỏa>)
desc_en: <Rage Level>: When our hero attacks, 30% chance to steal 100 energy points from the target (Can increase energy for <Rage Fire>)
desc_th: <ระดับโกรธ>: เมื่อฮีโร่ของเราโจมตี มีโอกาส 30% ที่จะขโมยพลังงาน 100 จุดจากเป้าหมาย (สามารถเพิ่มพลังงานสำหรับ <ไฟโกรธ>)
desc_in: <Tingkat Amarah>: Saat pahlawan kami menyerang, ada 30% peluang mencuri 100 poin energi dari target (Dapat meningkatkan energi untuk <Amarah Api>)
desc_ph: <Antas ng Galit>: Kapag ang aming bayani ay umaatake, may 30% chance na manakaw ng 100 energy points mula sa target (Puwedeng magdagdag ng energy para sa <Galit ng Apoy>)
desc_ma: <Tahap Amarah>: Apabila wira kami menyerang, ada 30% peluang mencuri 100 mata tenaga daripada sasaran (Boleh meningkatkan tenaga untuk <Amarah Api>)

desc: <Rage Trigger>: Using small skills or normal attacks gain extra 100 energy points (Can increase energy for <Rage Fire>)
desc_vn: <Kích nộ>: Sử dụng kỹ năng nhỏ hoặc đánh thường nhận thêm 100 điểm tức (Có thể nâng cao điểm tức cho <Nộ hỏa>)
desc_en: <Rage Trigger>: Using small skills or normal attacks gain extra 100 energy points (Can increase energy for <Rage Fire>)
desc_th: <จุดกระตุ้นโกรธ>: ใช้สกิลเล็กหรือโจมตีปกติจะได้รับพลังงานเพิ่ม 100 จุด (สามารถเพิ่มพลังงานสำหรับ <ไฟโกรธ>)
desc_in: <Pemicu Amarah>: Menggunakan skill kecil atau serangan normal mendapat tambahan 100 poin energi (Dapat meningkatkan energi untuk <Amarah Api>)
desc_ph: <Trigger ng Galit>: Gumamit ng maliit na skill o normal attack upang makatanggap ng dagdag na 100 energy points (Puwedeng magdagdag ng energy para sa <Galit ng Apoy>)
desc_ma: <Pencetus Amarah>: Menggunakan skill kecil atau serangan biasa mendapat tambahan 100 mata tenaga (Boleh meningkatkan tenaga untuk <Amarah Api>)

desc: <Berserk>: Using non-ultimate skills, each 1% energy provides 1% increased damage (Can increase energy for <Rage Fire>)
desc_vn: <Bạo nộ>: Sử dụng kỹ năng không phải là tuyệt kỹ, mỗi 1% tức sẽ cung cấp 1% tăng sát thương gây ra (Có thể nâng cao điểm tức cho <Nộ hỏa>)
desc_en: <Berserk>: Using non-ultimate skills, each 1% energy provides 1% increased damage (Can increase energy for <Rage Fire>)
desc_th: <บ้าคลั่ง>: ใช้สกิลที่ไม่ใช่สกิลสุดยอด แต่ละ 1% ของพลังงานจะเพิ่มความเสียหายที่สร้างขึ้น 1% (สามารถเพิ่มพลังงานสำหรับ <ไฟโกรธ>)
desc_in: <Kegilaan>: Menggunakan skill bukan ultimate, setiap 1% energi memberi 1% peningkatan damage (Dapat meningkatkan energi untuk <Amarah Api>)
desc_ph: <Berserk>: Gumamit ng skill na hindi ultimate, bawat 1% energy ay nagbibigay ng 1% dagdag na damage (Puwedeng magdagdag ng energy para sa <Galit ng Apoy>)
desc_ma: <Kegilaan>: Menggunakan skill yang bukan ultimate, setiap 1% tenaga memberikan 1% peningkatan kerosakan (Boleh meningkatkan tenaga untuk <Amarah Api>)

desc: <Life Shield>: At battle start, creates a shield that absorbs 10% damage based on the user's health for all allies (Effects like <Armor Shield, Immunity Shield, Nourishing Shield, Trigger Shield, Break Shield, Guard Shield> each can increase the shield by 4%)
desc_vn: <Thuẫn sinh>: Khi bắt đầu trận đấu, tạo một lớp khiên hấp thụ 10% sát thương bằng máu của bản thân cho toàn bộ đồng minh (Các hiệu ứng như <Thuẫn giáp, Thuẫn miễn, Thuẫn dưỡng, Thuẫn kích, Thuẫn phá, Thuẫn thủ> mỗi cái có thể nâng cao lớp khiên thêm 4%)
desc_en: <Life Shield>: At battle start, creates a shield that absorbs 10% damage based on the user's health for all allies (Effects like <Armor Shield, Immunity Shield, Nourishing Shield, Trigger Shield, Break Shield, Guard Shield> each can increase the shield by 4%)
desc_th: <โล่ชีวิต>: เมื่อต้นการต่อสู้ สร้างโล่ดูดซับความเสียหาย 10% ของเลือดตัวเองให้กับเพื่อนร่วมทีมทั้งหมด (ผลเช่น <โล่เกราะ, โล่ป้องกัน, โล่ฟื้นฟู, โล่กระตุ้น, โล่แตก, โล่ป้องกันตัว> แต่ละอย่างสามารถเพิ่มโล่อีก 4%)
desc_in: <Perisai Hidup>: Saat mulai pertempuran, menciptakan perisai menyerap 10% damage dari HP pengguna untuk seluruh sekutu (Efek seperti <Perisai Armor, Perisai Imun, Perisai Penyembuh, Perisai Pemicu, Perisai Pecah, Perisai Pelindung> masing-masing dapat menambah perisai 4%)
desc_ph: <Shield ng Buhay>: Sa simula ng laban, gumagawa ng shield na sumisipsip ng 10% damage mula sa HP ng gumagamit para sa lahat ng kakampi (Mga epekto tulad ng <Shield ng Armor, Shield ng Immunity, Shield ng Pagpapagaling, Shield ng Trigger, Shield ng Pagputol, Shield ng Depensa> bawat isa ay maaaring magpataas ng shield ng 4%)
desc_ma: <Perisai Hidup>: Pada permulaan pertempuran, mencipta perisai yang menyerap 10% kerosakan berdasarkan HP pengguna untuk semua sekutu (Kesan seperti <Perisai Zirah, Perisai Imun, Perisai Penyembuh, Perisai Pencetus, Perisai Pecah, Perisai Pelindung> masing-masing boleh meningkatkan perisai sebanyak 4%)

desc: <Armor Shield>: While shield exists, provides 20% double defense for it (Can enhance <Life Shield>)
desc_vn: <Thuẫn giáp>: Khi lớp khiên tồn tại, cung cấp 20% phòng thủ đôi cho nó (Có thể nâng cao lớp khiên cho <Thuẫn sinh>)
desc_en: <Armor Shield>: While shield exists, provides 20% double defense for it (Can enhance <Life Shield>)
desc_th: <โล่เกราะ>: ขณะที่โล่อยู่ จะเพิ่มการป้องกันคู่ 20% ให้กับโล่ (สามารถเพิ่ม <โล่ชีวิต>)
desc_in: <Perisai Armor>: Saat perisai ada, memberikan 20% pertahanan ganda untuk perisai tersebut (Dapat meningkatkan <Perisai Hidup>)
desc_ph: <Shield ng Armor>: Habang may shield, nagbibigay ng 20% double defense dito (Puwedeng pataasin ang <Shield ng Buhay>)
desc_ma: <Perisai Zirah>: Semasa perisai wujud, memberikan 20% pertahanan berganda kepadanya (Boleh meningkatkan <Perisai Hidup>)

desc: <Immunity Shield>: While shield exists, immune to control and negative effects (Can enhance <Life Shield>)
desc_vn: <Thuẫn miễn>: Khi lớp khiên tồn tại, miễn dịch kiểm soát và hiệu ứng tiêu cực (Có thể nâng cao lớp khiên cho <Thuẫn sinh>)
desc_en: <Immunity Shield>: While shield exists, immune to control and negative effects (Can enhance <Life Shield>)
desc_th: <โล่ป้องกัน>: ขณะที่โล่อยู่ จะป้องกันการควบคุมและผลลบ (สามารถเพิ่ม <โล่ชีวิต>)
desc_in: <Perisai Imun>: Saat perisai ada, kebal terhadap kontrol dan efek negatif (Dapat meningkatkan <Perisai Hidup>)
desc_ph: <Shield ng Immunity>: Habang may shield, immune sa control at negatibong epekto (Puwedeng pataasin ang <Shield ng Buhay>)
desc_ma: <Perisai Imun>: Semasa perisai wujud, imun terhadap kawalan dan kesan negatif (Boleh meningkatkan <Perisai Hidup>)

desc: <Trigger Shield>: Each attack adds 20% true damage based on current shield value (Can enhance <Life Shield>)
desc_vn: <Thuẫn kích>: Mỗi lần tấn công thêm 20% sát thương thật từ giá trị lớp khiên hiện tại (Có thể nâng cao lớp khiên cho <Thuẫn sinh>)
desc_en: <Trigger Shield>: Each attack adds 20% true damage based on current shield value (Can enhance <Life Shield>)
desc_th: <โล่กระตุ้น>: แต่ละครั้งที่โจมตี จะเพิ่มความเสียหายจริง 20% จากค่าปัจจุบันของโล่ (สามารถเพิ่ม <โล่ชีวิต>)
desc_in: <Perisai Pemicu>: Setiap kali menyerang menambah 20% damage nyata dari nilai perisai saat ini (Dapat meningkatkan <Perisai Hidup>)
desc_ph: <Shield ng Trigger>: Bawat pag-atake ay nagbibigay ng 20% true damage batay sa kasalukuyang halaga ng shield (Puwedeng pataasin ang <Shield ng Buhay>)
desc_ma: <Perisai Pencetus>: Setiap kali menyerang menambah 20% kerosakan benar berdasarkan nilai perisai semasa (Boleh meningkatkan <Perisai Hidup>)

desc: <Guard Shield>: When hit by a critical strike, all allies receive a shield equal to 10% max health of the user (Can enhance <Life Shield>)
desc_vn: <Thuẫn thủ>: Khi bị đánh bạo kích, tất cả đồng minh nhận một lớp khiên bằng 10% máu tối đa của bản thân (Có thể nâng cao lớp khiên cho <Thuẫn sinh>)
desc_en: <Guard Shield>: When hit by a critical strike, all allies receive a shield equal to 10% max health of the user (Can enhance <Life Shield>)
desc_th: <โล่ป้องกันตัว>: เมื่อติดคริติคอล จะให้เพื่อนร่วมทีมทั้งหมดได้รับโล่เท่ากับ 10% ของเลือดสูงสุดของตัวเอง (สามารถเพิ่ม <โล่ชีวิต>)
desc_in: <Perisai Pelindung>: Saat terkena serangan kritikal, semua sekutu mendapat perisai sebesar 10% HP maksimum pengguna (Dapat meningkatkan <Perisai Hidup>)
desc_ph: <Shield ng Depensa>: Kapag tinamaan ng critical hit, lahat ng kakampi ay nakakakuha ng shield na katumbas ng 10% max HP ng gumagamit (Puwedeng pataasin ang <Shield ng Buhay>)
desc_ma: <Perisai Pelindung>: Apabila terkena serangan kritikal, semua sekutu mendapat perisai sebanyak 10% HP maksimum pengguna (Boleh meningkatkan <Perisai Hidup>)

desc: <Break Shield>: When shield breaks, deals damage to all enemies equal to 6% max health (Can enhance <Life Shield>)
desc_vn: <Thuẫn phá>: Khi lớp khiên vỡ, gây sát thương cho toàn bộ kẻ địch bằng 6% máu tối đa (Có thể nâng cao lớp khiên cho <Thuẫn sinh>)
desc_en: <Break Shield>: When shield breaks, deals damage to all enemies equal to 6% max health (Can enhance <Life Shield>)
desc_th: <โล่แตก>: เมื่โล่แตก จะสร้างความเสียหายแก่ศัตรูทั้งหมด เท่ากับ 6% ของเลือดสูงสุด (สามารถเพิ่ม <โล่ชีวิต>)
desc_in: <Perisai Pecah>: Saat perisai hancur, memberikan damage kepada semua musuh sebesar 6% HP maksimum (Dapat meningkatkan <Perisai Hidup>)
desc_ph: <Shield ng Pagputol>: Kapag nawasak ang shield, nagbibigay ng damage sa lahat ng kalaban na katumbas ng 6% max HP (Puwedeng pataasin ang <Shield ng Buhay>)
desc_ma: <Perisai Pecah>: Apabila perisai hancur, memberikan kerosakan kepada semua musuh sebanyak 6% HP maksimum (Boleh meningkatkan <Perisai Hidup>)

desc: <Nourishing Shield>: When shield breaks, recovers 5% max health of user (Can enhance <Life Shield>)
desc_vn: <Thuẫn dưỡng>: Khi lớp khiên vỡ, hồi phục 5% máu tối đa của bản thân (Có thể nâng cao lớp khiên cho <Thuẫn sinh>)
desc_en: <Nourishing Shield>: When shield breaks, recovers 5% max health of user (Can enhance <Life Shield>)
desc_th: <โล่ฟื้นฟู>: เมื่โล่แตก จะฟื้นฟูเลือด 5% ของตัวเอง (สามารถเพิ่ม <โล่ชีวิต>)
desc_in: <Perisai Penyembuh>: Saat perisai hancur, memulihkan 5% HP maksimum pengguna (Dapat meningkatkan <Perisai Hidup>)
desc_ph: <Shield ng Pagpapagaling>: Kapag nawasak ang shield, nagpapagaling ng 5% max HP ng gumagamit (Puwedeng pataasin ang <Shield ng Buhay>)
desc_ma: <Perisai Penyembuh>: Apabila perisai hancur, memulihkan 5% HP maksimum pengguna (Boleh meningkatkan <Perisai Hidup>)

desc: <Bamboo Break>: Deals extra 30% damage to units with health above 70% (If combined with <Leaf Sweep>, adds 20% crit rate)
desc_vn: <Thế như phá trúc>: Gây thêm 30% sát thương cho đơn vị có máu trên 70% (Nếu có cả <Thế như phá trúc> và <Thu phong quét lá>, thêm 20% tỷ lệ bạo kích)
desc_en: <Bamboo Break>: Deals extra 30% damage to units with health above 70% (If combined with <Leaf Sweep>, adds 20% crit rate)
desc_th: <ไม้ไผ่แตก>: สร้างความเสียหายเพิ่ม 30% กับยูนิตที่มีเลือดมากกว่า 70% (ถ้ามีทั้ง <ไม้ไผ่แตก> และ <ใบไม้ปัด> เพิ่มอัตราคริติคอลอีก 20%)
desc_in: <Serangan Bambu>: Memberi tambahan 30% damage pada unit dengan HP di atas 70% (Jika digabung dengan <Sapuan Daun>, menambah 20% chance kritikal)
desc_ph: <Pagsira ng Kawayan>: Nagdudulot ng dagdag na 30% damage sa unit na may HP higit sa 70% (Kung may <Pagsira ng Kawayan> at <Hampas Dahon>, dagdagan ng 20% crit rate)
desc_ma: <Serangan Buluh>: Memberikan tambahan 30% kerosakan kepada unit dengan HP lebih dari 70% (Jika mempunyai <Serangan Buluh> dan <Sapuan Daun>, menambah 20% kadar kritikal)

desc: <Leaf Sweep>: Deals extra 40% damage to units with health below 30% (If combined with <Bamboo Break>, adds 20% crit rate)
desc_vn: <Thu phong quét lá>: Gây thêm 40% sát thương cho đơn vị có máu dưới 30% (Nếu có cả <Thế như phá trúc> và <Thu phong quét lá>, thêm 20% tỷ lệ bạo kích)
desc_en: <Leaf Sweep>: Deals extra 40% damage to units with health below 30% (If combined with <Bamboo Break>, adds 20% crit rate)
desc_th: <ใบไม้ปัด>: สร้างความเสียหายเพิ่ม 40% กับยูนิตที่มีเลือดต่ำกว่า 30% (ถ้ามีทั้ง <ไม้ไผ่แตก> และ <ใบไม้ปัด> เพิ่มอัตราคริติคอลอีก 20%)
desc_in: <Sapuan Daun>: Memberi tambahan 40% damage pada unit dengan HP di bawah 30% (Jika digabung dengan <Serangan Bambu>, menambah 20% chance kritikal)
desc_ph: <Hampas Dahon>: Nagdudulot ng dagdag na 40% damage sa unit na may HP mababa sa 30% (Kung may <Pagsira ng Kawayan> at <Hampas Dahon>, dagdagan ng 20% crit rate)
desc_ma: <Sapuan Daun>: Memberikan tambahan 40% kerosakan kepada unit dengan HP kurang dari 30% (Jika mempunyai <Serangan Buluh> dan <Sapuan Daun>, menambah 20% kadar kritikal)

desc: <Blood Invasion>: Each 1% lifesteal increases damage by 5% (If combined with <Wing Spread>, each 1% lifesteal steals 1% double defense from target)
desc_vn: <Huyết xâm>: Mỗi 1% hút máu của anh hùng tăng 5% tăng sát thương (Nếu có cả <Huyết xâm> và <Dực vĩ>, mỗi 1% hút máu của anh hùng sẽ ăn cắp 1% phòng thủ đôi của mục tiêu)
desc_en: <Blood Invasion>: Each 1% lifesteal increases damage by 5% (If combined with <Wing Spread>, each 1% lifesteal steals 1% double defense from target)
desc_th: <การบุกรุกเลือด>: ทุก ๆ 1% ดูดเลือดจะเพิ่มความเสียหาย 5% (ถ้ามีทั้ง <การบุกรุกเลือด> และ <ปีกกาง> ทุก ๆ 1% ดูดเลือดจะขโมย 1% การป้องกันคู่ของเป้าหมาย)
desc_in: <Invasi Darah>: Setiap 1% lifesteal meningkatkan damage sebesar 5% (Jika digabung dengan <Sayap Terbuka>, setiap 1% lifesteal mencuri 1% pertahanan ganda musuh)
desc_ph: <Pag-atake ng Dugo>: Bawat 1% lifesteal ay nagdaragdag ng 5% damage (Kung may <Pag-atake ng Dugo> at <Pagpakpak>, bawat 1% lifesteal ay nagnanakaw ng 1% double defense ng target)
desc_ma: <Serangan Darah>: Setiap 1% lifesteal meningkatkan kerosakan sebanyak 5% (Jika mempunyai <Serangan Darah> dan <Sayap Terbuka>, setiap 1% lifesteal mencuri 1% pertahanan berganda musuh)

desc: <Wing Spread>: Each 1% lifesteal increases speed by 5% (If combined with <Blood Invasion>, each 1% lifesteal steals 1% double defense from target)
desc_vn: <Dực vĩ>: Mỗi 1% hút máu của anh hùng tăng 5% tốc độ (Nếu có cả <Huyết xâm> và <Dực vĩ>, mỗi 1% hút máu của anh hùng sẽ ăn cắp 1% phòng thủ đôi của mục tiêu)
desc_en: <Wing Spread>: Each 1% lifesteal increases speed by 5% (If combined with <Blood Invasion>, each 1% lifesteal steals 1% double defense from target)
desc_th: <ปีกกาง>: ทุก ๆ 1% ดูดเลือดจะเพิ่มความเร็ว 5% (ถ้ามีทั้ง <การบุกรุกเลือด> และ <ปีกกาง> ทุก ๆ 1% ดูดเลือดจะขโมย 1% การป้องกันคู่ของเป้าหมาย)
